missions.title: Get Your Travel Bag Back
missions.description: After a long journey, you've arrived in Lumiose City! But a Pokémon named Pancham has run off with your bag... Chase after it to reclaim your belongings
missions.guide: As you arrive in Lumiose City, you get stopped by Taunie/Urbain who wish for your help to record a video for tourism in the city. However, as they get interrupted by Jett welcoming people to the city, your bag gets stolen. You need to follow the Pancham that stole the bag. When you catch up to it, you have to battle its trainer, and so you need to select a Pokémon that Taunie/Urbain has between Chikorita, Tepig and Totodile. Defeat Andi and the battle is won and you get your bag

missions.title: Escape from the Battle Zone
missions.description: The city changes a lot when the sun goes down. Find your way out of this "battle zone" and retreat to the safety of Hotel Z with the help of your new friend Taunie/Urbain.
missions.guide:
With your bag returned, you take up Taunie/Urbain's offer of going to a nearby hotel but it turns to night and the whole area turns into a Battle Zone. Your task is to escape the Battle Zone. However, before you can, you get stopped by a trainer. Defeat her and more appear, but a mysterious Floette soon arrives and scares them away.

You then go to the nearby Hotel, Hotel Z and meet its owner, AZ welcomes you and thinks you are there for a reason so offers you a room to stay in.

missions.title: A New Life in Lumiose City
missions.description: It's been one unexpected development after another, but your new life in Lumiose is off to an exciting start. Have your new friend Taunie/Urbain show you the ropes.
missions.guide:
The next morning, you go down to meet with Taunie/Urbain and learn that you are getting registered for the Z-A Royale, a special tournament that runs at night in the city, with the winners getting their wish granted. You also get invited into Team MZ and meet another member, Lida but, before too long, Taunie/Urbain challenge you to a battle Team MZ  Taunie/Urbain Chikorita Totodile Battle Type Items Level 5 Level 5 Attacks : Tackle Tail Whip Attacks : Tackle Leer Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item Team MZ  Taunie/Urbain Totodile Tepig Battle Type Items Level 5 Level 5 Attacks : Tackle Leer Attacks : Tackle Tail Whip Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item Team MZ  Taunie/Urbain Tepig Chikorita Battle Type Items Level 5 Level 5 Attacks : Tackle Tail Whip Attacks : Tackle Tail Whip Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item

After catching 5 Pokémon, you can go to the Research Lab where you meet the Acting Director, Mable. She welcomes you and offers you the prize and suggests you continue on with her requests to fill the Pokédex and get lots of rewards.

missions.title: Battling in the Z-A Royale
missions.description: To take part in a promotion match, you must first take on other Trainers in the battle zone and earn yourself a ticket. Clear this initial hurdle, then reach Rank Y
missions.guide: As it turns to night, the Battle Zone activates and it's your chance to rank up from Rank Z. Battle through the trainers until you get a Challenger Ticket where you can then face the Rank Z Promotion match against Zach, who wants to abolish all other forms of transport if he gets to Rank A. Defeat him and you will rank up to Rank Y.

missions.title: The City in the Shadow of Prism Tower
missions.description: Taunie/Urbain is here to show you more facets of Lumiose City. What kinds of experiences await you in this lively metropolis?
missions.guide: Taunie/Urbain have promised to show you around Lumiose City so they take you to their favourite spots including a Café near Prism Tower. When there, you will meet Vinnie, the secretary for Quasartico Inc. who explains the situation with the tower.

missions.title: Reaching Rank X
missions.description: Your opponent for your next promotion match has been decided: an office worker named Yvon. Earn points and get yourself a ticket so you can aim for Rank X
missions.guide: Immediately after helping Emma, you get your next Promotion Match through which is against a trainer called Yvon. Once again you need to battle through the Battle Zone at night in order to earn the Challenger Ticket to face Yvon. Defeat her to get to Rank X.

missions.title: Reaching Rank W
missions.description: Your next goal will be to reach Rank W. For now, you'll have to wait to find out who you'll be pitted against in your next promotion match. Your opponent for your next promotion match has been decided: a grade-schooler named Xavi. Earn points and get yourself a ticket so you can aim for Rank W!
missions.guide: The next day when you return to the hotel, you socialise more with Team MZ and Lida suggests Naveen open up to you. He is reluctant but eventually agrees if you defeat him in a battle. Defeat him and he opens up a bit about his family and why he's there

missions.title: Reaching Rank V
missions.description: Your next goal will be to reach Rank V. For now, you'll have to wait to find out who you'll be pitted against in your next promotion match. Your opponent for your next promotion match has been decided: a waiter named Rintaro. Earn points and get yourself a ticket so you can aim for Rank V!
missions.guide: Once again you start the day but as Lida leaves, AZ mentions that she has left her things and asks for you to go find here and give them to her. In Vert Sector 5 you can find her in the Battle Court where she's practicing dancing. She happily challenges you as a warm up. Defeat her and your Rank V promotion match gets decided.

missions.title: Chase That Mysterious Pokémon
missions.description: A mysterious Pokémon appeared before you, and it seems to want you to follow it...
missions.guide:
As you leave the Restaurant, Emma calls you and asks if you have seen the mysterious Pokémon, but that Pokémon has appeared in front of you and beckons for you to follow it. It takes you to a corner and brings you up onto a roof where an Absol is struggling. AZ and Emma arrive and learn the Absol is about to Mega Evolve. AZ sends his Lucario up with a Mega Ring so you can fight  the Mega Absol

Defeat it to calm it down and you will soon learn that some Pokémon are Mega Evolving. Absol appears and asks to come with you.

missions.title: The Secrets of Mega Evolution
missions.description: Mega Rings, Mega Stones, and bonds with your Pokémon... It seems there is much for you to learn before you'll truly understand Mega Evolution.
missions.guide: The next day, you get woken by Taunie/Urbain and soon they get called by Vinnie, and agrees to go visit him at Quasartico HQ, and has been told to bring you as well to talk about Rogue Mega Evolution. However, before you go, you get challenged so you can Mega Evolve the Absol you just got. Team MZ  Taunie/Urbain Bayleef Croconaw Manectric Battle Type Items Level 25 Level 25 Level 26 Attacks : Giga Drain Leech Seed Body Slam Disarming Voice Attacks : Aqua Jet Tackle Slash Bite Attacks : Thunder Fang Spark Bite Fire Fang Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : Manectite Team MZ  Taunie/Urbain Croconaw Pignite Manectric Battle Type Items Level 25 Level 25 Level 26 Attacks : Aqua Jet Tackle Slash Bite Attacks : Power-Up Punch Rollout Flame Wheel Tackle Attacks : Thunder Fang Bite Spark Fire Fang Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : Manectite Team MZ  Taunie/Urbain Pignite Bayleef Manectric Battle Type Items Level 25 Level 25 Level 26 Attacks : Power-Up Punch Rollout Flame Wheel Tackle Attacks : Giga Drain Leech Seed Body Slam Disarming Voice Attacks : Thunder Fang Bite Spark Fire Fang Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : Manectite

missions.title: A Rogue Mega Slowbro
missions.description: A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Slowbro in the Bleu District. Use your new Mega Ring and face this Slowbro in battle
missions.guide:
In the Bleu district, you will find Slowbro on an island in the water. Taunie/Urbain will wait for you and you two will challenge it together.

Slowbro will bounce around the stage and use moves including Water Pulse and Psybeam. Its main special charge move sets off a range of whirlpools out around it that do damage when they hit.

Defeat Slowbro and you will be given the Slowbronite

missions.title: A Rogue Mega Camerupt
missions.description: A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Camerupt in the Jaune District. Use your new Mega Ring and face this Camerupt in battle
missions.guide:
In the Jaune district, you will find Camerupt on a rooftop but before you can get up there, Tarragon says they have to tinker with the scaffolding and their staff members challenge you to a battle. Defeat them and you will be able to go up to the roof, and Lida will appear to help.

Camerupt will move around the stage and use moves like Earth Power against you and your Pokémon. Its main special move will send out volcanic rocks around the stage which will damage if hit. It will then charge up a wall of fire which will set the rocks off to explode in a chain reaction.

Defeat it and you will get the Cameruptite

missions.title: A Rogue Mega Victreebel
missions.description: A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Victreebel in the Magenta District. Use your new Mega Ring and face this Victreebel in battle
missions.guide:
In the Magenta District, you will find Victreebel just off of North Boulevard and Naveen will appear in order to help out.

Victreebel's main moves include Bullet Seed which sends out large seeds at you as well as Power Whip when you or your Pokémon are nearby. Its main special attack is Sludge Bomb which sends out a number of pools of poison which do damage and inflict the Poison status condition.

Defeat Victreebel and you will get the Victreebelite Mega Stone

missions.title: Reaching Rank E
missions.description: Your opponent for your next promotion match has been decided: the wildly popular streamer Canari. You'll have to track her down and defeat her to move up a rank
missions.guide:
Rendezvousing at the hotel, you get a notification of your next promotion match. This match is against Canari, the popular gaming streamer of whom Naveen is a big fan. Naveen is shocked as she doesn't really show her face much but has some idea on how to lure her out. However, he won't tell you as he doesn't want to impinge on her streaming. It's proposed that you battle Naveen and, if you win, then Naveen will help. Team MZ  Naveen Ariados Sableye Scraggy Battle Type Items Level 33 Level 33 Level 33 Attacks : Poison Jab Pin Missile Sticky Web Shadow Sneak Attacks : Shadow Claw Night Slash Confuse Ray Take Down Attacks : Brick Break Rock Tomb Power-Up Punch Headbutt Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item

Once in, you can reach Canari's Quiz Whiz Contest. The questions are true or false questions that have you go between various answers, with Naveen helping you out to make sure you choose wisely. Question 1: True or false? I’m crazy good at falling-block puzzle games! - True Question 2: True or false? Macarons are my favorite food! Choose ? for true or × for false! - False Question 3: True or false? Electric-type Pokémon are my fave! Choose ? for true or × for false! - True

This puts you in to round 2 which asks you to find her Eelektross's favourite dessert. This is a Lumiose Galette, but it's a Special Lumiose Galette  that is found at Café Gallant. Go there and you'll find Mani, another Canari fan who is equally knowledgable. Get the Lumiose Galette and return to the Electrical Substation to reach Round 3.

Round 3 has you battle with the other trainer, Mani who was one of the first members of DYN4MO

Go to Racine Construction and you will meet Tarragon again. He congratulates you on doing well but says you have to defeat him in abattle before he explains everything.

DYN4MO  Tarragon Hippowdon Diggersby Excadrill Battle Type Items Level 36 Level 36 Level 37 Attacks : Heavy Slam Amnesia Crunch Stealth Rock Attacks : Swords Dance Take Down Bounce Bulldoze Attacks : Swords Dance Dig Rock Slide X-Scissor Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : Excadrite

missions.title: A Job for Team MZ
missions.description: Vinnie has alerted you to three more cases of Rogue Mega Evolution. Take care of them all to keep Lumiose City safe
missions.guide: After ranking up, Vinnie contacts again and says that three more Pokémon are set to Mega Evolve throughout Lumiose City and tasks you to complete it once again. Team MZ divides up once more with Taunie/Urbain taking Beedrill, Lida taking Hawlucha and Naveen taking Banette

missions.title: A Rogue Mega Beedrill
missions.description: A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Beedrill in the Vert District. Face it in battle using the Mega Ring you were granted
missions.guide:
Beedrill can be found on another rooftop in the Vert District.

Beedrill will rush around the stage and use the move Lunge to do major damage. It also brings out several Kakuna onto the stage that inflict various damage and act as distractions. Its main Special attack has it charge up and use pin missile, sending out numerous missiles to that home in towards you, needing avoiding.

Defeat it and you will get the Beedrillite Mega Stone.

missions.title: A Rogue Mega Hawlucha
missions.description: A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Hawlucha in the Magenta District. Face it in battle using the Mega Ring you were granted
missions.guide:
When you reach the Magenta District, a woman comes up to you and asks if you have seen Hawlucha. She explains it's not her Pokémon but she sees it every now and again to give it food but can't find it. Lida realises the Hawlucha is likely the one to Rogue Mega Evolve. You find it on a roof but need to chase it down. Reach it and you battle it.

Hawlucha is a rapid physical Pokémon that will rush up towards you and your Pokémon and use moves including Brick Break and Air Slash to do damage and will ocassionally use flying Press. Its main special is a massive Flying Press where it jumps up into the air and slams down dealing massive damage in a shockwave nearby.

Defeat it and you'll get the Hawluchite Mega Stone

missions.title: A Rogue Mega Banette
missions.description: A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Banette in the Jaune District. Face it in battle using the Mega Ring you were granted
missions.guide:
In the Jaune District, you will find Naveen but Banette is nowhere to be seen. However, Banette appears out of the shadows and immediately Mega Evolves.

Banette starts off with a gimmick instantly and uses Double Team which makes multiple copies of it that act as decoys and will all use Shadow Ball against you. This is while Banette will use Phantom Force and Confuse Ray against you to do damage. Its main special has it charge up and rush towards with Shadow Claw

Defeat it for the Banettite Mega Stone but L will appear and commends you for helping to save Pokémon from the pain of Rogue Mega Evolved Pokémon. He says your task is to hone your skills until you can support Zygarde and questions why Emma is following him and Zygarde.

missions.title: Reaching Rank D
missions.description: This is no time for a promotion match— Ivor's younger sister, Gwynn, has gone missing! You should focus on helping locate her first. Now that Gwynn has been located, it's time to get back to work on your real goal: defeating Ivor in a promotion match
missions.guide:
The next day, Taunie/Urbain challenge you again.

Soon after, you get your Promotion Match to reach Rank D and it's Ivor of the Fist of Justice. Earn your Challenger's Ticket and  go to the Justice Dojo to find Ivor but he can't battle you right now as his sister, Gwynn has gone missing and he needs your help to find her. You suggest going to Emma at the Looker Bureau to find out

Defeat her again and she will point you to where Gwynn discussed, to where the X, Y and Z axes don't meet and talks about a Pokémon her Partner Pokémon can't beat. This gestures you towards a fountain. This fountain is the Clawitzer fountain in Bleu Sector 7

Go there and you  figure out that you can go to the sewers, but there's water in the way. Use Ice Beam on the fountain to clear the way and enter the sewers.

Going through the sewers, you find a locked door and feel a Klefki has the key. After defeating the Klefki, you find its keys don't work for the area so Ivor breaks through the gate. Continue walking through the Sewers and you will figure out that there's nu culprit and Gwynn hasn't been kidnapped. She has just come to the sewers for some peace as Ivor is a lot to handle. She challenges you to a battle.

missions.title: A Request from the Rust Syndicate
missions.description: The Rust Syndicate's requests have started to arrive, leaving you little choice but to do as they ask. And you'd better complete their tasks well if you hope to get rid of that debt
missions.guide:
The next day, Taunie/Urbain is nowhere to seen but Lida has received a mysterious call. You then recieve a call that says they're a member of the Rust Syndicate and that Taunie/Urbain owe them a lot of money. They ask for you to come to the area to discuss it so you go there with Lida.

When there, you get stopped by two Grunts. Defeat them then Philippe, of the Rust Syndicate is disheartened by you defeating the grunts and decides to challenge you to a battle.

When you have defeated him, he introduces you to Corbeau, the head of the Syndicate and says that you have to do various jobs for him to pay off the loan and the interest of the debt accrued by Taunie/Urbain as they borrowed money to pay for their ads for Hotel Z

Return to the Hotel and you'll have a meeting to discuss it, but Vinnie calls and says that three Mega Evolved Pokémon have appeared that you need to sort out. Once again it is split, Taunie/Urbain with Mega Mawile, Lida with Mega Barbaracle and Naveen with Mega Ampharos

The group are a collection of Ghost-type Pokémon. You have to defeat them in battle and you will have done the job. While the Pokémon leave, one Gengar remains with the person moving into the house.

missions.title: A Rogue Mega Mawile
missions.description: A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Mawile in the Magenta District. Face it in battle using the Mega Ring you were granted
missions.guide:
In the Magenta District, you can find Mawile on the corner of a building.

Mawile is a physical attacker and will charge at you and your Pokémon using moves including Play Rough and Crunch. It will frequently chase after you to inflict the damage on you. Its main special has it jump out of the field and charge up, shooting waves of energy balls out towards the stage which explode on impact for you to avoid.

missions.title: A Rogue Mega Barbaracle
missions.description: A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Barbaracle in the Bleu District. Face it in battle using the Mega Ring you were granted
missions.guide:
In the Bleu District, you will find Barbaracle in some water.

Barbaracle will use moves including Rock Slide to do damage from a distance while also running around and using Power-Up Punch to do damage and boost its attack. It will also summon some Binacle as backup that act as interference and can do damage. When it uses its Special move, it will charge up and then jump to you and use Close Combat, attacking with lots of fists before shooting out an energy beam at you.

Defeat it to get the Barbabraclite and Zygarde & L will appear. L suggests he believes this is happening because of the renovation work on Prism Tower and that Quasartico Inc. is responsible.

missions.title: A Rogue Mega Ampharos
missions.description: A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around an Ampharos in the Rouge District. Face it in battle using the Mega Ring you were granted
missions.guide:
In the  Rouge District you will find Ampharos. However, the way up to it is not working and Gwynn appears. Thanking you for before, she says she will help you but you have to battle first.

Defet her and she will spot the Phantump blocking the Holovator and allows you up to the roof

Ampharos starts off using moves such as Dragon Pulse to do damage from a distance and will  run to you and use Breaking Swipe at a close distance. Its special has it charge up and then use Discharge unleashing a lot of damage close range. This then leaves puddles of electricity around the field for a short time which damage and can paralyze.

missions.title: Reaching Rank C
missions.description: Your opponent for your next promotion match has been decided: Corbeau, the boss of the Rust Syndicate. Get a Challenger's Ticket, then take him on to move up a rank
missions.guide:
After you have helped Corbeau with the jobs, he, impressed by you, decides that the interest for the debt has been paid off and says that he wants to battle you. Your next Promotion Match comes through and it is against Corbeau.

Earn yourself a Challenger's Ticket and return to the Rust Syndicate to battle him and his Mega Scolipede.

Defeat Corbeau and return to the hotel. However, Corbeau soon comes in and asks about the hospitality of the hotel and books to stay the night.

The next morning, Corbeau comes down and thanks for a good night and gives Taunie/Urbain a big tip for a ajob well done; the amount of which accounts for all of Taunie/Urbain's debt, which they then pay off.

missions.title: A Showdown on the Battle Court
missions.description: With the crisis over Taunie/Urbain's debt settled, you and the rest of the team finally have a quiet moment. Why not take a break and enjoy a Pokémon battle on a real battle court
missions.guide: The next day, AZ decides the time is finally right, and he probably should have done it before, and gives Naveen and Lida their own Mega Rings and Mega Stones so they can Mega Evolve their partners. They then suggest battling you in order to test, though Lida cannot evolve her Staryu yet, she still wants to battle.

missions.title: An Invitation from the SBC
missions.description: Vinnie has alerted you to three more cases of Rogue Mega Evolution, and keeping the city safe must come before Jacinthe's tournament. Get these three taken care of
missions.guide:
After defeating Naveen & Lida, you go to the Nouveau Café with Team MZ and start to relax, but when you do, a maid, Lebanne, comes over and gives an invitation to Hotel Richissime to participate in a special tournament with the SBC.

Hesitant to go dressed as you are, you all go to a Boutique on Verdant Avenue where you get offered a special outfit to go.

Head to Hotel Richissime and you are welcomed in and find that Canari, Gwynn, Ivor, Tarragon, Corbeau and Philippe were all invited. As the tournament is about to begin, Taunie/Urbaine gets a call from Vinnie; more Rogue Mega Evolutions are about to happen so you head off to deal with it, angering Jacinthe, the head of the SBC

missions.title: A Rogue Mega Froslass
missions.description: A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Froslass in the Bleu District. Face it in battle using the Mega Ring you were granted
missions.guide:
In the Bleu District, you will have to find Mega Froslass by Amylis Park. When there, Naveen will be there and be mesmerised by how Froslass looks, but before too long Froslass Mega Evolves

Froslass will use Phantom Force to move out of the way and will use the move Icy Wind to do some strong damage from a distance. Its charge move is Avalanche which unleashes lots of giant icicles throughout the stage. After the first wave breaks, the second wave embeds in the  stage allowing Froslass to move again and use Blizzard doing major damage, needing you to hide behind the pillars of ice to protect yourself

Defeat Froslass and a hologram of Jacinthe will appear and is shocked by the development of Rogue Mega Evolution, and say you need to return to the tournament.

missions.title: A Rogue Mega Altaria
missions.description: A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around an Altaria in the Magenta District. Face it in battle using the Mega Ring you were granted
missions.guide:
In the Magenta District, you will find Lida and the Mega Altaria. Lida is hesitating about her strength and asks if she is actually helping you all out. Reassure her and the battle begins.

Altaria will use Dragon Pulse to get some damage in at a distance and will occassionally fly up and use Moon Blast which will move down and home in on you. Its special has it charge up and use Twister, sending a giant cyclone out to do damage which smaller cyclones will fly out in all directions..

Defeat Altaria and once again Jacinthe will appear and says it's marvelous how you defeated it and the strength is what she has been looking for in the tournament.

missions.title: A Rogue Mega Venusaur
missions.description: A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Venusaur in the Jaune District. Face it in battle using the Mega Ring you were granted
missions.guide:
Finally, in the park in the Jaune District, you will find Venusaur in the gazebo in the park and you will face off against it with Taunie/Urbain.

Venusaur will leap around the stage frequently and use Power Whip to damage close range. It will also use Bullet Seed to send out a stream of seeds to do massive damage. Its special has it send out seeds that land on the ground creating thorn hazards which do damage if touched. They can be removed with Fire or Flying moves. A second will have it charge up and use Solar Beam.

Defeat it and Jacinthe's hologram appears again and she says she'll stop haunting you if you return to the tournament.

missions.title: Reaching Rank B
missions.description: Your opponent for your next promotion match has been decided: the SBC's own Jacinthe. Get a Challenger's Ticket, then take her on to move up a rank
missions.guide:
After defeating the Rogue Mega Evolutions, you get your next Promotion Match alert that your next challenger is Jacinthe, showing that she is insistent on battling you. You go to the tournament but before you can leave, Lebanne appears and insists you go to the tournament and she has been authorised to get you there under any means necessary and unleashes herself so challenges you to a battle.

Defeat her and Taunie/Urbain will say that you were going there anyway

The battles are against Canari, then Ivor and then Corbeau.

Defeat it and Lysandre mentions that everyone needs to think about why Zygarde has started to appear and hopes you find the answer, before he and Zygarde leave in order for L to collect more Zygarde Cells

Defeat her and she thanks you for the battle and congratulates you on Ranking up to Rank B

missions.title: A Summons from Vinnie
missions.description: Vinnie has tasked you with handling three more cases of Rogue Mega Evolution. Take care of them all to keep Lumiose City safe
missions.guide:
The next morning, Vinnie summons you to Quasartico Inc. on hehalf of Jett. While there she explains what happened with the renovation project and how five years ago, Lumiose City was failing and so they started the project to create a city that belonged to both people and Pokémon but as they began work on Prism Tower, it started releasing energy sand Rogue Mega Evolution came to be.

Vinnie then mentions that three more Rogue Mega Evolution Pokémon have begun to appear so Team MZ has a meeting and the group are divided once more

missions.title: A Rogue Mega Dragonite
missions.description: A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Dragonite in the Vert District. Face it in battle using the Mega Ring you were granted
missions.guide:
In the Vert District you will find a Dragonite. Taunie/Urbain say to put your guard up as its Mega Evolution has only just recently been discovered.

Dragonite will use the move Air Slash to send a massive amount of damage out in one direction and sometimes use Flamethrower for further damage at a distance.. It will sometimes fly up and change position. Close range it uses the move Outrage to damage Pokémon in front of it. Its special move has it charge up and unleash Hurricane through the stage aiming towards you and, as it moves, there will be Thunder hitting the stage at random locations doing even more damage. Its second special has it fly up and unleash a Hyper Beam in the middle of the stage to create an area that then explodes across the whole stage

Defeat Mega Dragonite to get the Dragonitite

missions.title: A Rogue Mega Tyranitar
missions.description: A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Tyranitar in the Jaune District. Face it in battle using the Mega Ring you were granted
missions.guide:
In Jaune District, in the middle of a small field you will find Tyranitar, which you need to battle with Naveen. Naveen is happy as his Scrafty should do well against it.

Tyranitar will use Rock Slide at a distance to do damage and will use Sand Tomb to create a massive cyclone on the ground of sand that does some chip damage. Its main special  has it charge out and do a line of Stone Edges aimed towards you. In the second half, this gets increased to a group of three Stone Edge

missions.title: A Rogue Mega Starmie
missions.description: A high concentration of Mega Power has been detected around a Starmie in the Bleu District. Face it in battle using the Mega Ring you were granted
missions.guide:
Finally in the Bleu District, you will meet with Lida to go get the Starmie. However, when on your way you get stopped by two Rust Syndicate Grunts who say you can't go in. efeat them and you will go to Philippe who insists you battle with him first. Rust Syndicate  Philippe Steelix Scizor Aggron Skarmory Battle Type Items Level 56 Level 56 Level 56 Level 57 Attacks : Stone Edge Heavy Slam Stealth Rock Breaking Swipe Attacks : Protect Iron Head X-Scissor Air Slash Attacks : Iron Tail Rock Slide Earthquake Ice Punch Attacks : Drill Run Night Slash Steel Wing Protect Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : Skarmorite Defeat Philippe and he will give Lida a Water Stone, suggesting that she evolves her Stayryu into Starmie. She asks if she should evolve her Staryu before the battle.

Defeat Philippe and he will give Lida a Water Stone, suggesting that she evolves her Stayryu into Starmie. She asks if she should evolve her Staryu before the battle.

Defeat it to get the Starminite Mega Stone

missions.title: Reaching Rank A
missions.description: Your opponent for your next promotion match has been decided, and it's...someone called Grisham? The photo doesn't tell you much—finding them is going to be tough
missions.guide:
After you have defeated the Rogue Pokémon, you reconvene at the Hotel. When there, AZ gets asked how he determines the strongest Mega Evolution user and he mentions that it' up t Floette to decide.

You then get your next Promotion Match, the winner gets to Rank A. This is against a mysterious person called Grisham but nobody knows who he is. It's suggested you wait but Taunie/Urbain say you have to find it and wonder who you can ask. The decision is to get Emma's help so you go to the Looker Bureau. She says she'll help but challenges you to a battle to make sure you're safe.

Defeat Emma and she will ask what you know of Team Flare and give the history of what Team Flare did and how Lysandre reappeared calling himself L. She mentions about her old ties with someone from Team Flare and that's how she learned of Grisham, one of the young trainers Team Flare taught. She recommends you go to Mable to get more information

When you go there, you ask about a meeting with Grisham. They announce that you have found your opponent and that their own goals have led them to the Z-A Royale and you can't be defeated. Grisham offers to explain the whole thing but Grisella tries to stop him. They send you to a defunt Café in the city to talk more

Defeat Griselle and Grisham will heal your Pokémon and explain what happened five years ago with Lysandre and the ultimate weapon, which he explains as AZ's creation. He finds it laughable and tells you to go into the Lysandre Labs in the café, a facility that was used for research in the past. He says to go in and see the evidence for yourself

He explains that when the weapon activated, the device in Prism Tower also activated sensing danger and has become a threat to Lumiose City and will soon enter a frenzied state. He says the only way to bring it under control is with Floette. He says to talk to Grisham and do what needs to be done.

Grisham asks if you learned what you needed to and is shocked Lydsandre is alive, though doesn't remember them. Grisham then gives you an ultimatum to give him AZ'S Floette so he can Rank up and protect Prism Tower.

It is then time to go to Grisham with a Challenger's Ticket. Grisham asks if you will give him Floette and evetually accepts the battle even though you won't give Floette in order to prove that he is worthy of Floette's power and can protect the city.

missions.title: Prism Tower's Dark Turn
missions.description: A strange light emanates from Prism Tower. The time to act has come, even sooner than you'd thought it might. What can you and your friends do to protect Lumiose City?
missions.guide: The next day, after Taunie/Urbain mention that they have also reached Rank A, Floette starts to appear in pain and there's a large boom so you all go to the roof. The tower starts to glow and AZ mentions that Floette reacted because Ange is about to go rogue with the excessive Mega Power which can cause Rogue Mega Evolution everywhere. AZ sents Team MZ and Floette to Centrico Plaza

missions.title: Operation Protect Lumiose
missions.description: Throw aside past rivalries and work together to save the city and your friends! You know your destination—now go find Zygarde where it waits for you
missions.guide:
With the tower in peril, Taunie/Urbain calls and mentions they're ok as Mega Floette is looking after them. They can't control the tower as it's acting like a Rogue Mega Evolution and it's trying to fire off Mega Floette's moves. They see Zygarde in the Magenta District and think that it's there to help you so uggests going there.

Other Pokémon around start Mega Evolving so it's up to Team MZ to face them. Defeat them and Lida starts a meeting to create a plan. Other trainers from the city start appearing in Holo caster and offer their help to get a path through for you to reach Zygarde.

Get through the paths with the trainers, defeating Rogue Mega Evolved Pokémon along the way until you reach Zygarde

This battle comes in two parts. On the ground, you have to take on two flowers, a Blue one and a red one. They both attack with distance and close attacks requiring you to protect yourself and attack. They have no weaknesses. Periodically, the Light of Ruin from Ange will come through and attack you, and you need to get under Complete Forme Zygarde for protection. If you defeat the flowers, this gives Zygarde a chance to unleash its moves, but its Core Enforcer needs time to charge. On the third defeat of the flowers, Core Enforcer is ready and it will unleash on Ange and defeat it Hyperrogue Ange Floette Hyperrogue Ange Floette Hyperrogue Ange Floette HP: 25,000 HP: 25,000

Ange has been defeated ad Taunie/Urbain emerge from the tower with Floette. AZ celebrates and mentions how the choices we make shape our sorrows

missions.title: The Future of Lumiose City
missions.description: Things are beginning to return to normal in Lumiose after the trouble at the tower. What will you and Taunie/Urbain decide to do with the wishes you earned by reaching Rank A?
missions.guide: Several days later, Team MZ lament the loss of AZ and decide to keep the hotel running. However, you get called by Jett and Vinnie to go to Prism Tower to discuss your wish. With discussion, the wish eventually gets determined to be continuing the Z-A Royale onwards and you all get registered for the Infinite Royale

missions.title: The Infinite Z-A Royale
missions.description: The curtains have drawn back on the Infinite Z-A Royale! Collect Challenger's Tickets so you can take part in reward matches for the fabulous prizes they offer
missions.guide:
With the Infinite Royale, you have the ability to go through and battle ad infinatum and battle through all the challengers earning rewards. The opponents you face in Reward matches are the same for the first 20 matches.

After defeating them, Emma will arrive and say that Taunie/Urbain and Jett had both asked her to look for someone, and it turns out they were looking for eachother. Jett is Taunie/Urbain's grandmother who pushed away their mother after disagreeing on the direction of the company. Taunie/Urbain mention their mother regretted never speaking to Jett again and gives Jett a message their mother wanted to know. Jett apologises and mentions how she is taking responsibility for what happened to Lumiose and asks for Taunie/Urbain to take over the company. After accepting, Taunie/Urbain mention that they won't have time to battle as much any more and ask for you to take Floette with you.

missions.title: The One That Gives
missions.description: Work together with Mable, who was once a member of Team Flare, to protect Lumiose City from the threat of "the one that gives."
missions.guide:
After the first round of the Infinite Royale, you get a call to return to the Hotel. When there, L will appear and will mention how more of his memory has returned and explains about the two Legendary Pokémon that they did experiments with. He mentions that there are reports of some strange readings from the Wild Zones which he believes it's the two Legendary Pokémon.

After doing that, Mable will mention how she has reports of Xerneas being in Wild Zone 11 and is concerned that Xerneas' energy will set off the tower so says for you to catch it.

After defeating it, Mable appears and congratulates you and thanks you for your help

missions.title: The One That Takes
missions.description: Work together with Grisham and Vinnie to protect Lumiose City from the threat of "the one that takes."
missions.guide:
After the first round of the Infinite Royale, you get a call to return to the Hotel. When there, L will appear and will mention how more of his memory has returned and explains about the two Legendary Pokémon that they did experiments with. He mentions that there are reports of some strange readings from the Wild Zones which he believes it's the tow Legendary Pokémon

When you reach the roof, you will see Yveltal fly down and challenge you.

Grisham and Griselle appear and congratulate you on getting the job done and Grisham laments that their old fixation held them captive but now they can relax and go for a coffee break

missions.title: To Keep the World in Balance
missions.description: What is it that people and Pokémon ought to do to preserve the world's beauty? What does Zygarde think? What do you believe?
missions.guide:
After capturing Xerneas & Yveltal, when you return to the hotel you will find L. He will mention that both are vital to maintaining balance but in excess can destroy it. His memories have started to come back and he tried to give too much then take too much but Zygarde helped him find balance. He then challenges you to a battle.

Defeat him in battle and he mentions how he'd have never fired the weapon five years ago if he understood the five children that stood against him. Zygarde then beckongs you to the Prism Tower

Defeat that and Zygarde will change to Complete Forme. Complete Forme tends to target you down more than yuor Pokémon and unleasehs powerful attacks including Land's Wrath, Thousand Arrows and more. It will somethimes charge up a special and unleashe a Core Enforcer on the field, which has two small gaps that are protected from damage, and it will drop a massive Land's Wrath that cannot be avoided. Defeat it and Lysandre will suggest throwing the Poké Ball to catch it

Defeat Zygarde and L will mention that you combining your power with Zygarde gives him hope for the future of the city and thanks you. He hopes that he can make the dream of people fluorishing, but it could take three thoussand years so will travel vast to search for ways to make the world the best it  can be, and says goodbye.

missions.title: A Big Ol' Bunnelby
missions.description: The requester says he saw a giant Bunnelby in an alleyway outside of the wild zones. Meet the requester at the location.
missions.guide:
In Rouge Sector 6, you will get told about how Trevelle saw a big Bunnelby in an  alleyway. If you go to the alleyway you will see the Bunnelby, a Level 10 Alpha Bunnelby, and have to battle it or catch it. Trevelle will arrive and explain how regions in older times had Alpha Pokémon and people feared them.

This mission unlocks Alpha Pokémon in the game

missions.title: A Use for an Evolution Stone
missions.description: A Trainer wants a Pikachu she can use a Thunder Stone on. She's offered to trade you her Heracross in exchange.
missions.guide: In the Shopping Centre off Rouge Street, you will find a lady, Tracie, who has got an evolution stone. She would like for you to trade a Pikachu to her in exchange for her Heracross. Once you do the trade, she will immediately evolve the Pikachu into Raichu. This Raichu will be seen here in perpertuity.

missions.title: Sableye in the Cemetery
missions.description: The requester dropped something precious in the cemetery, which has now become a wild zone. Your job is to retrieve the item.
missions.guide: Outside of Wild Zone 4 you will find a woman, Moire, who lost her wedding ring when she was in the cemetery visiting the grave of a loved one. She says a Pokémon called Sableye was the one who startled her. Battle the Sableye in the cemetery and you will get the ring back. Bring it back to her and she will say she will put a request in that the ring be left on her grave when she passes so perhaps the Sableye will find it there

missions.title: A Break Time Battle
missions.description: This worker's on his break, but he says he'll happily get back to work and have the Holovator up and running right away if you'll have a Pokémon battle with him.
missions.guide: In Rouge Sector 1 by Rouge Plaza, you will find a Holovator that is out of action. Sommi is working on it but is on break. He says he will fix it if you have a battle with him. Defeat him and he will fix the Holovator for you.

missions.title: I'd Like to See an Ekans
missions.description: A young girl wants to see the Snake Pokémon Ekans up close. Catch an Ekans and show it to her.
missions.guide: In Magenta Sector 1, you will meet a girl called Ismene who has so many questions about the Pokémon Ekans but was told that it's not safe to go into the Wild Zones. She asks for you to bring an Ekans to her so she can see one up close. Add one to your party and talk to her and she'll be happy and say she'll catch one of her own one day

missions.title: Long-Range Moves Have Style
missions.description: Distan seems to think that attacking from a distance with long-range moves is the most stylish strategy. Take him on in a Pokémon battle to see if he's right.
missions.guide:
In Bleu Sector 4 you will meet a trainer called Distan who is a big fan of Long Range moves. He will ask for you to have a battle so he can show that long range moves are the best.

Rich Boy  Distan Binacle Fletchling Skiddo Battle Type Items Level 16 Level 16 Level 16 Attacks : Water Gun Bubble Beam Attacks : Ember Swift Attacks : Razor Leaf Mud Shot Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item

missions.title: A Feisty Chespin
missions.description: A wild Chespin has decided to pick a fight with a taxi cab. The driver can't move the cab with Chespin in the way-see if you can help her out.
missions.guide: Near Academie Etoilie, you will find a Chespin that is trying to battle a car. A nearby trainer suggests you battle with it to calm it down. Defeat it and it will keep battling you. Aftert the third battle, Axi will suggest that the Chespin go with you instead.

missions.title: Get Well, Fennekin
missions.description: You came across a wild Fennekin that seems lethargic and listless. It apparently refuses to eat food, and even taking it to a Pokémon Center did nothing. What else can you do
missions.guide: In Magenta Sector 2, you will find a man, Jardin, who has found an ill Fennekin. He suggests that a Revitalizing Twig will be able to restore the Fennekin to full health and suggests you go find them, suggesting you find the herablist in Café Classe for help. Go there and they will say they don't have anything but note they have been seen in Wild Zone 5 but he can't go as there are too many wild Pokémon there. Go to the area and find the Revitalizing Twig near the Alpha Whirlipede and Jardin will suggest the Fennekin go with you.

missions.title: A Challenge from Froakie
missions.description: A Froakie currently reigns as the fastest to complete a scaffolding course. Try to beat its time to show it how fast humans can be.
missions.guide: In Jaune Sector 8, you will find a Froakie on some construction sites. The worker, Surv, says that it also acts as a course to complete and that Froakie is the Champion. If you beat it in 30 seconds, then you will have beaten Froakie. When you beat it, you will have to do a second course nearby in 40 seconds and a third course on North Boulevard in 50 seconds. Beat the courses and you will get Froakie.

missions.title: Skiddo's Fragrant Leaves
missions.description: The requester says she wants to make perfume using Skiddo leaves. What kind of aroma will this perfume have
missions.guide: In Vernal Avenue, a woman called Odette says she is a perfumer and asks for you to bring a Skiddo to her to use its leaves to help create a fragrance. If you do, she will borrow the leaves and make the fragrance immediately

missions.title: The Kakuna Master
missions.description: A young girl is training hard to become the strongest Kakuna user. Let her show off her Kakuna in battle.
missions.guide: In Rouge Sector 1, a girl wants to show off her Kakuna and asks for you to battle her. Battle her and she will show her Kakuna and it will immediately evolves. She decides that the Kakuna she had was special since it evolved without her telling it to

missions.title: The Many Flowers of Flabébé
missions.description: A hairstylist wants to expand her hair-color palette by seeing every color of flower that a Flabébé might adopt.
missions.guide: Talk to Vivace in South Boulevard and she will  ask to see each flower of Floette. This is done individually and not all at once. If you show her each Flabébé, it will inspire her to make some hair dye colours that you can get at all salons; one for each colour Flabébé as well as aqua, purple and passion pink. She then says she is inspired to catch her own.

missions.title: Stumped at the Fountain
missions.description: The requester is an artist working on a painting for a contest. As she was doing some sketches, however, some brambles showed up, ruining the scenery.
missions.guide: When you talk to this trainer, she says she is an artist and wants to paint a fountain but some brambles appeared and she asks for you to clear the brambles. Clear them and she will thank you, only for the brambles to come back. Do this several more times and they will see that a Phantump is here. This will cause inspiration and she will create a painting with the Phantump

missions.title: Slurpuff's Café Visit
missions.description: You've been roped into chaperoning a grumpy Slurpuff. Take it to Café Soleil and hang out there until Slurpuff is satisfied.
missions.guide: In Bleu Sector 10, outside the café the owner will say that his Slurpuff hasn't been itself lately and asks for you to escort it to another café where it gets its favourite treats. Walk with it to the café and get it its treats, while also helping you learn that the café owner and Slurpuff had a disagreement.

missions.title: A Sensitive Audino
missions.description: The requester says she is worried about her Audino, which is behaving strangely. Maybe a Pokémon battle will calm Audino down...
missions.guide: In Rouge Sector 1, you will meat Hea who thinks there's something up with their Audino as they keep fussing over her. She asks for you to battle with the Audino to find out what's wrong. When you do, it turns out that the battle helped reinvigorate Hea as she had suffered from burnout which is what Audino was trying to inform her of.

missions.title: The Budew Show
missions.description: An old gentleman has invited you to join what seems to be an event showcasing Budew. Bring a Budew with you to participate.
missions.guide: In the Pokémon Center, you will get told of a special Budew show by a man who sees potential in you. He asks for you to take a Budew to Bleu Sector 6 where it can take part in a special contest between all Budew. When you bring your Budew, your Budew will stun the judges and you will end up winning

missions.title: A Shiny Mareep
missions.description: The requester says she saw a Shiny Mareep in Wild Zone 1! Or at least she thinks she did, but she's not sure. Help her discover the truth.
missions.guide: Outside of the north exit of Wild Zone 1, a trainer called Duve will say how she saw a different coloured Mareep in the Wild Zone. She asks for you to go find it. It can be found on the rooftop of a building within the zone. Find it and you will be able to capture it.

missions.title: A Pan-tastic Pot of Tea
missions.description: The requester says he needs Pansage, Pansear, and Panpour to create the perfect cup of tea. Find all three Pokémon and bring them to the requester.
missions.guide: In Vert Sector 3, Servando mentions how he wants to make a new drink and asks for inspiration from a Pansage, Pansear and Panpour. Bring them to him and he will create a brand new drink that will be on sale at the Café

missions.title: Poisonous, Paralyzing Strategies
missions.description: Paralysis will slow your Pokémon down, while poison will gradually drain their HP. Which is stronger? Find out for yourself
missions.guide: In Vert Sector 3 you will encounter two trainers arguing over when status condition is better. They will each ask for a battle for you to determine which one is the most effective in battle.

missions.title: A Berry Clever Plan
missions.description: The requester has come up with a battle plan in which he gives his Pokémon Berries to hold. He seems very confident, but do his skills measure up
missions.guide: In the battlefield in Wild Zone 6, you will find Ticien who has come up with some strategies using Berries and wants to battle you to prove how strong they are.

missions.title: Spewpa in the Museum
missions.description: Find all the Spewpa hiding throughout the museum. Apparently there are 12 in total.
missions.guide: In Lumiose Museum, you will find a couple who have mentioned how they have a dozen Spewpa but they have run amok in the  museum and are hiding in all the exhibits. Explore the museum and look for the Spewpa. Once you have found all 12 Spewpa, return to the pair and they will find a thirteenth Spewpa has shown up. They are unable to look after an additional Spewpa so ask for you to take it. This Spewpa will evolve into the Marine Pattern Vivillon Spewpa Level 9 OT: Yours ID: Yours Hold Item: None Random Nature. Date of Receiving Lumiose Museum. Met at Lv. 9 Poison Powder String Shot Harden Stun Spore

missions.title: A Call from Mable
missions.description: Mable called and asked you to come to the Pokémon Research Lab. What is she up to now
missions.guide: You will receive a call from Mable and she will ask for yo to come to the Pokémon Research Lab. When there, she will mention how her predecessor left her with a task of giving some Pokémon to trainers she sees potential in. She offers you a choice between Bulbasaur, Charmander and Squirtle

missions.title: Underneath the Holovator
missions.description: A Pokémon has made its home in the ground under a Holovator, causing it to malfunction. Unfortunately for the Pokémon, you'll have to get it to move...
missions.guide: On Vernal Avenue, you will find a broken Holovator. Terra will say that a Pokémon has dug in front of it which has broken it. Go to the mound where the Pokémon is and you will find a Diggersby. Defeat it and the elevator will be fixed

missions.title: An Abra Playmate
missions.description: The requester has asked for an Abra to play tag with. He's offered to trade you his Riolu in exchange.
missions.guide: In Academie Etoile, a trainer called Bond will ask for you to trade as he thinks Abra's teleporting will come in useful for playing tag. He offers a Riolu in exchange for an Abra. Once done, he will comamnd the Abra to teleport him but it falls asleep and then teleports while asleep, causing Bond to make chase Riolouie Level 25 OT: Bond ID: 348226 Hold Item: None Random Nature. Date of Receiving a link trade. Met at Lv. 25 Work Up Rock Smash Screech Detect

missions.title: Trubblesome Patrons
missions.description: Wild Trubbish are gathering at Café Pokémon-Amie, causing the business to lose customers! Save the café by taking the Trubbish somewhere else.
missions.guide: By a café in Autumnal Avenue, Fumi asks for your help as Trubbish has developed a taste for the scraps at the restaurant. She's fine with it but they cause an odour and so she asks for you to lure them away. She gives you the Tasty Trash and asks for you to take it to the end of the alleyway with the Trubbish

missions.title: Burn, Litleo, Burn
missions.description: Litleo's fire is absolutely essential for this restaurant's delicious food. Help Litleo get fired up for cooking with a battle.
missions.guide: Outside of Restaurant le Yeah, Armie says that his Litleo is not giving a hot enough flame to help cook and mentions that only battles bring out its full potential so asks for you to battle in order to bring out its heat.

missions.title: Restored from a Fossil
missions.description: A researcher who has a fossil restoration device has given you some money to buy a fossil. Pick up either a Jaw Fossil or a Sail Fossil from the Stone Emporium.
missions.guide: In the Pokémon Research Lab on 2F, you will meet a scientist, Reg, who wants to revive a fossil. He will give you 20,000 PokéDollars to go buy a fossil at the Stone Emporium, offering you the choice between Jaw Fossil or Sail Fossil. Bring the fossil back to him and revive it, and he will then give you that Pokémon. After that, he will revive any fossil, including the Old Amber, for you.

missions.title: Who Says Normal Is Weak
missions.description: Unexceptional, ordinary-these are the traits of the Normal type. But ordinary doesn't mean weak! See for yourself what Normal types can do.
missions.guide: In Bleu Sector 7 in the park area you will find a man, Marnole who insists that Normal-types are the best type as they don't have any weaknesses. He will challenge you to a battle in order to prove this to you.

missions.title: Full Course of Battles: One Star
missions.description: Enjoy a relaxing full course of battles at Restaurant Le Nah. Please note it is considered poor etiquette to heal your Pokémon while the course is being served.
missions.guide: When you go to Restaurant Le Nah, you will be offered a chance to battle trainers. Normally this costs but to lure you in this will be offered for free.

missions.title: Show Me a Mega Camerupt
missions.description: A designer of color contacts wants to see a Mega Camerupt to get some inspiration. Mega Evolve a Camerupt during your battle with her.
missions.guide: In Vernal Avenue, you will meet a trainer named Arden. She is stuck for inspiration for contact lenses so would like for you to battle her using a Mega Camerupt. Battle her and use the Mega Camerupt in battle to get the Fired Up & Lovestruck Contact Lenses Artist  Arden Watchog Krokorok Sharpedo Battle Type Items Level 35 Level 35 Level 35 Attacks : Super Fang Crunch Detect Dig Attacks : Crunch Dig Sand Tomb Brick Break Attacks : Aqua Jet Crunch Night Slash Bite Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item

missions.title: Show Me a Mega Sableye
missions.description: A designer of color contacts wants to see a Mega Sableye to get some inspiration. Mega Evolve a Sableye during your battle with her.
missions.guide: In Vernal Avenue, you will meet a trainer named Arden. She is stuck for inspiration for contact lenses so would like for you to battle her using a Mega Sableye. Battle her and use the Mega Sableye in battle to get the Starry Eyes and Black Void Contact Lenses Artist  Arden Watchog Krokorok Carbink Battle Type Items Level 35 Level 35 Level 35 Attacks : Bite Crunch Detect Confuse Ray Attacks : Crunch Dig Sand Tomb Bite Attacks : Dazzling Gleam Flash Cannon Power Gem Rock Throw Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item

missions.title: Show Me a Mega Medicham
missions.description: A designer of color contacts wants to see a Mega Medicham to get some inspiration. Mega Evolve a Medicham during your battle with her.
missions.guide: In Vernal Avenue, you will meet a trainer named Arden. She is stuck for inspiration for contact lenses so would like for you to battle her using a Mega Medicham. Battle her and use the Mega Medicham in battle to get the Poké Ball & Cyber Contact Lenses Artist  Arden Watchog Krokorok Meowstic Battle Type Items Level 35 Level 35 Level 35 Attacks : Super Fang Crunch Detect Shadow Ball Attacks : Crunch Dig Sand Tomb Shadow Claw Attacks : Disarming Voice Psybeam Swift Reflect Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item

missions.title: Who Has the Bigger Magikarp
missions.description: The requester is very proud of the massive Magikarp he caught. Find a Magikarp even larger than one with a size classification of XL to show him there's always a bigger fish
missions.guide: In Vert Sector 4, a man Kingsley says he ahas the largest Magikarp and says you can't prove otherwise. If you bring an Alpha Magikarp to him, he will be stunned and say that it's the jumping power that matters mosyt and suggests a jump contewst. When your Magikarp wins, he will relent

missions.title: Moves That Put Up a Wall
missions.description: There are moves that reduce damage to your Pokémon by creating barriers around them. The requester wants to battle you to show off strategies centered on these moves.
missions.guide: In Jaune Sector 8, a child will say Pokémon are more nuanaced and you can't win just with force and talks about how you can make barriers. Defeat him and he will explain the difference between the barriers.

missions.title: Guidance from a Yoga Master
missions.description: The requester's Meditite is apparently having trouble focusing. Find the legendary yoga master to see if they can help.
missions.guide: In Jaune Street, you will find a person whose Meditite is struggling to concentrate and they mention that there is a Yoga Master known around who could help them. Go to Wild Zone 3 and climb the tower to find the Yoga Master. Paix will appear and will ask for advice. It turns out she hasn't been feeding the Meditite enough

missions.title: Some Friendly Competition
missions.description: Some Pokémon don't evolve unless you become very close with them. Battle the Pokémon that the requester has raised with tender loving care
missions.guide: In Magenta Sector 5, you will find the trainer Chou who battles with two Pokémon that evolved through friendship and asks for you to battle so she can show how close she is with her Pokémon

missions.title: Binacle by the Boatload
missions.description: Binacle are swarming the requester's prized boat, preventing him from taking it out for a ride. Chase away the Binacle for him.
missions.guide: On Magenta Street along the canal, you will find a man, Barnie, who wants to go out on his boat but five Binacle are stopping him. He asks for you to clear them so you battle all five at once. Defeat them and they will return. Barnie learns that they like the boat and offer for them to join him on the boat.

missions.title: Chasing Status
missions.description: Status moves can power up your Pokémon or hinder the opponent. Two Trainers who are skilled in using both kinds of status moves have challenged you to a battle.
missions.guide: In Magenta Street, you will find an atheltic couple Deb & Maxen who feel they have the best strategies using moves that can raise or lower Pokémon's stats, so they challenge you to a battle.

missions.title: Slowpoke for Slowpoke
missions.description: Galarian Slowpoke apparently look different compared to Slowpoke from other regions. Trade your own Slowpoke for the requester's Galarian Slowpoke.
missions.guide: In South Boulevard you will find a sightseer called Quille who has come from the Galar region. He is looking for a Slowpoke and is offering a Galarian Slowpoke in trade. Do the trade to complete the mission.

missions.title: A Holovator Without Power
missions.description: The requester is having trouble getting a Holovator up and running, as apparently there isn't enough electric power. Maybe you can give it a zap
missions.guide: In South Boulevard, there is a broken elevator that is not getting enough power. Elec asks for you to use an Electric-type move against the Holovator to reactivate it

missions.title: Watch Out for Traps
missions.description: Moves that leave a lingering effect on the battlefield are commonly known as traps. Experience their nasty effects for yourself in a Pokémon battle.
missions.guide: In Vert Sector 9, you will encounter Piè who talks about moves that can trap the opponent such as Spikes and offers a battle in order to demonstrate.

missions.title: A Fan of Fairy Types
missions.description: The requester says Fairy-type Pokémon are her favorites. Take her on in battle using your own favorite Pokémon.
missions.guide: In the Wild Zone 6 battlefield, you can find Faye who is a big fan of Fairy-type Pokémon. She asks for a battle to show their true power.

missions.title: A Big Weedle Problem
missions.description: An alpha Weedle is ruining the requester's garden by gnawing on all the plants. It keeps coming back even if it gets chased away, so try catching it with a Poké Ball instead.
missions.guide: In Magenta Sector 36, you will speak to a man who complains that there are too many Weedle devouring the plants in the garden and that an Alpha Weedle is a big culprit. He believes if Weedle is chased away then the others would stop. He asks you to catch it. If you catch it, he starts to feel empty and asks for you to give him the Alpha Weedle.

missions.title: Vanillite's Fragrant Snow
missions.description: The requester says she now wants to make perfume using snow from Vanillite. What aroma will the perfume have this time
missions.guide: In Vernal Avenue, Odette will ask for your help again, this time with a Vanillite so she can use its snow to help make a perfume. Bring a Vanillite to her and she will use it.

missions.title: On Maintenance Duty
missions.description: Durstin is a maintenance worker who takes his job very seriously, but now he's so thirsty that nothing seems to be getting done. Maybe a drink will get him back on track
missions.guide: On South Boulevard, there's a broken Holovator but the repairman, Durstin, won't fix it. He takes his duty seriously but he is very thirsty. Bring him a drink (Fresh Water, Lemonade, Soda Pop or Moomoo Milk) and he will thank you and fix the Holovator

missions.title: Pidgeot Soaring High
missions.description: The Courier Colis is a huge fan of the Bird Pokémon Pidgeot. He's particularly fond of the move Fly and wants to share his enthusiasm with you.
missions.guide: At Saison Canalside, a man called Colis will talk about how his favourite Pokémon is Pidgeot and he loves Flying-types, deciding to even be a courier because the logo is a bird Pokémon. He asks for you to battle him so he can show what the move Fly can do.

missions.title: Becoming a Furfrou Trimmer
missions.description: The requester wants to open up a Pokémon salon where Furfrou can have their fur trimmed. Help her improve her skill by showing her Scyther a move
missions.guide:
After the Furfrou shop closed down in Lumiose 5 years ago, Mirte in Jaune Sector 6 wants to set up a new shop to trim Furfrou using her Scyther. However, her Scyther is struggling with moves. She asks for you to show the move Slash with one of your Pokémon in order to help Scyther learn it.

Completion of this adds the Heart Trim, Star Trim and Diamond Trim as Trims you can give your Furfrou

missions.title: All Tied Up
missions.description: A man is wrapped up in Pokémon webbing and dangling from a tree. How did he even end up there? Have your Pokémon use a move to get him down.
missions.guide: In Rogue Sector 5 near the plaza, a man will be seen stuck in some web and hanging from a tree. He asks for your help to come down and that you need to use a powerful move to unleash it. If you use a move with a Base Power of 100 or more, he will come free. It turns out his Spinarak hung him up from the tree when they had a disagreement with him.

missions.title: Hit and Heal
missions.description: Some moves deal damage to the opponent while also restoring the user's HP. Battle the requester to get a glimpse of these moves in action.
missions.guide: In Hibernal Avenue, Piresse mentions how some Pokémon moves can be used to heal the Pokémon while also doing damage and offers a battle in which to demonstrate.

missions.title: Just a Few Questions for You...
missions.description: You ran into a Goomy out and about at night. After a moment, someone called out-a police officer. Seems she's got some questions for you...
missions.guide: In Magenta Sector 1, a Goomy can be found sitting on a bench. As you approach it, a Police officer comes by and mentions that goo has been left around and questions if you are Goomy's trainer. She doesn't believe you despite the truthful answers and demands you battle her. After battling her, Goomy's trainer arrives and Goomy leaves with them. Licier apologises for not believing you.

missions.title: Floette Frolicking with Flowers
missions.description: A hairstylist wants you to battle all five of her Floette at once so she can get new ideas for hair colors.
missions.guide: Return to South Boulevard and you will find Viviace has obtained 5 Floette, one of each colour. She is thrilled and wants to see them in battle to get inspiration for new hair colours. Defeat all five in the same battle and she will come up with 9 different Pastel Hair styles

missions.title: Numel Frozen Solid
missions.description: The requester wants you to help her Numel, which has been frozen solid. Hit it with a high-powered Fire-type attack to thaw it out
missions.guide: In Wild Zone 12, Gelli asks for your help as her Numel is frozen in a bit of ice. She struggles to figure it out and asks for you to use a Fire-type move to free her Numel

missions.title: The Most Electrifying Eelektrik
missions.description: Inspired by Canari, the requester is raising a whole bunch of Eelektrik. He says he'll evolve the strongest one into Eelektross, but will his plan work out
missions.guide: After becoming known as the biggest Canari fan in the quiz, Anguil can be found in Bleu Sector 5 and asks for a battle so he can decide which Eelektrik to evolve into Eelektross to be like Canari's. After defeating him, Mani comes up and explains that Canari didn't evolve the stronged Eelektrik but trained her Eelektross to become the strongest.

missions.title: Get ENERGIZED
missions.description: The move Focus Energy makes a Pokémon's moves more likely to land as critical hits. Face the requester, who isn't afraid to use this frightening move
missions.guide: By Quasartico Inc., Foco can be found in the Battlefield and talks about how moves such as Focus Energy can be useful to boost a Pokémon's Critical Hit rate. They offer to battle to demonstrate.

missions.title: Carvanha, Menace of the Deep
missions.description: A certain movie director is making a thriller film. He needs a Carvanha for an important scene-lend him one so he can complete his work.
missions.guide: At the Saison Canalside, a director is wanting to film a movie but needs a Carvanha alone to be in it, as all Carvanha in the wild come in schools. Bring your Carvanha out for filming and it will play along but instead gets a bit nervous as it is on its own, which the Director turns into part of the movie.

missions.title: We'll Just Muscle Our Way Through
missions.description: A Holovator seems to have a poor connection to the power grid. The requester claims that giving it a good whack will get it working. Hit it with a Fighting-type physical move.
missions.guide: In Jaune Sector 6, another Holovator is unable to be used. Médiera asks for you to help as she can normally fix it with a well-placed punch but it's not working. Bring a Pokémon with a Fighting-type move to fix it.

missions.title: The Camerupt Entrepreneur
missions.description: The requester says he's going to start a new business with the help of his Camerupt. What exactly is he scheming
missions.guide: In Bleu Sector 1, you can find Hérup at the entrance to the sewers underground. Hérup's plan is to start a new business venture through the Sewers, with him having found access by Wild Zone 5. Follow him into the sewers and he will find a room and say that, with his Camerupt, he is going to turn it into a sauna. He challenges you to a battle. After defeating him, he'll realise the business may not be the best idea, but sees how wild Pokémon came due to the heat from his Camerupt and still decides to open a sauna, but for both people and Pokémon.

missions.title: Better to Detect Than to Protect
missions.description: Protect and Detect both prevent the user from taking damage, but apparently there is a slight difference between the two.
missions.guide: In Bleu Sector 6, Claire says that the move Detect is much better than the move Protect and challenges you to a battle to show you.

missions.title: A Rematch with Hawlucha
missions.description: Hawlucha gazes over the city, hungering for an intense battle. Satisfy its desire by facing it once more.
missions.guide: In Magenta Sector 3, you will find Dora who helped you with Hawlucha when it was about to Rogue Mega Evolve. She mentions that since then Hawlucha hasn't seemed like itself and feels you should find it to rematch it. Battle it and she will be happy and asks Hawlucha if she can help it out and be its trainer

missions.title: Full Course of Battles: Two Stars
missions.description: Enjoy a satisfying full course of battles at Restaurant Le Yeah. Please note it is considered poor etiquette to heal your Pokémon while the course is being served.
missions.guide: When you go to Restaurant Le Yeah, you will be offered a chance to battle trainers. Normally this costs but to lure you in this will be offered for free.

missions.title: My Favorite Holovator
missions.description: A Rust Syndicate grunt has chosen one particular Holovator as his favorite, for some reason. Beat him in a battle to get him out of the way.
missions.guide: In Bleu Sector 3 by Bleu Plaza, there's a Holovator that a Rust Syndicate Grunt is insisting is his favourite and only he can use. He challenges you to a battle. Defeat him and he'll relent and give you access Rust Syndicate  Grunt Trubbish Roselia Mawile Battle Type Items Level 45 Level 45 Level 46 Attacks : Sludge Bomb Poison Jab Take Down Amnesia Attacks : Pin Missile Razor Leaf Giga Drain Poison Jab Attacks : Iron Head Crunch Knock Off Draining Kiss Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item

missions.title: Becoming a Pro Furfrou Trimmer
missions.description: The requester wants to add to her repertoire of Furfrou styles. Help out by showing her Scyther another move
missions.guide: Return to the Furfrout cutting area in Jaune Sector 6 and Mirte wants to try out some new styles. She asks for you to bring a Pokémon that knows Razor Leaf to help Scyther with its cuts. Use it against the Substitute. This will give inspiration and adds the Debutante, Matron and Dandy Trims as possible options

missions.title: An Extra-Large Gogoat
missions.description: The requester has recently started a courier business. He says he needs an extra-large Gogoat in order to haul bigger loads. See if you can find one for him.
missions.guide: In Magenta Sector 8, Lugo mentions how he started a Gogoat Carrier service but his Gogoat tend to be a bit on the small side so can't handle the larger packages. He asks for you to bring an XL Gogoat to him for him to use. Bring the Gogoat to him and he will be elated and be able to do his tasks. He then mentions how people used to ride Gogoat across the city

missions.title: Let It Rain, Let It Pour
missions.description: The requester claims her Pokémon are stronger when it's raining. Have a battle in the rain so you can witness their might.
missions.guide: In Rouge Sector 7, you will meet Cielestine who says about how weather effects can boost Pokémon's moves. She asks for you to battle her to demonstrate but you need to wait until it Rains in order to do so. You can come back or sit and wait with her.

missions.title: Apartment Block Eeriness
missions.description: It seems a certain apartment building has become haunted. The requester reports hearing strange noises from the rooftop and wants you to go check it out.
missions.guide: In Rouge Sector 7, you get asked by Ante to investigate some issues happening that they feel are paranormal. Speakers in empty rooms start playing and some sounds have been coming from the roof. She asks you to go to the roof to investigate. There, you find a Dedenne that you have to make chase. Once you catch up with it, you battle it. Defeat it and Ante will be relieved that it wasn't a paranormal activity and just a Dedenne stealing electricity. She says she will help the Dedenne find a trainer

missions.title: Investigating with Shuppet
missions.description: A police officer says that he needs a Shuppet to help with his investigations. Do your part in keeping the peace of Lumiose by bringing him one.
missions.guide: In Bleu Sector 1, a police officer, Rancun, will ask for you to bring him a Shuppet to help him solve some crimes as it an pick up on negative emotions. After giving it to him, it goes off towards a house alongside the canal. However, Rancun soon explains it's his house and his wife comes out. He asks Shuppet why it brought him here and he soon learns that his wife was getting negative feelings due to the amount he was working. Rancun accepts he has been working too late and apologises, striving to do better.

missions.title: Sylveon the Soother
missions.description: Sylveon's soothing powers should put a stop to fighting! That's what the requester thinks, anyway. Help her bring the nearby squabbles to a peaceful conclusion.
missions.guide: By the Coulant Waterway, Calma says that her Sylveon has been picking up on a lot of angry emotions lately and asks for you to go around and see what arguments are happening so Sylveon can calm them. However, with each check of an argument, it seems to all be a misunderstanding but Calma says Sylveon could have done more, and the two start to fight. Calma realises what happened and she apologises to Sylveon

missions.title: The Best Use for Leftovers
missions.description: What happens when you have a Pokémon hold Leftovers? Have a battle with the hard- working waitress and see for yourself.
missions.guide: In Vert Sector 7, Seizi talks about how useful Leftovers are as she takes her job as a Waitress seriously and doesn't want to waste food. She insists on battling you to show you the wonders of the Leftovers item.

missions.title: A Sky Battle, for Old Times' Sake
missions.description: Apparently Sky Battles were a bit of a fad in Kalos until just a few years ago. Try having a battle using only Flying-type Pokémon.
missions.guide: On a roof in Magenta Sector 8, Volli suggests having a battle using only Flying-type Pokémon. Defeat him and he will mention how Sky Battles were a thing in Kalos in the past and that you could reignite people's passion for it.

missions.title: Who's the Strongest, Huh
missions.description: Some Rust Syndicate grunts are arguing about whose Pokémon is the strongest. Help them come to a conclusion.
missions.guide: In Estival Avenue, you will find two Rust Syndicate Grunts arguing about which of their Pokémon is strongest. They insist on battling you to prove that they are right.

missions.title: The Burning Gaze of Watchog
missions.description: The alpha Watchog is a menace, staring down anyone who dares approach with its glowing red eyes. Defeat it to make the Holovator safe to approach.
missions.guide: In Magenta Sector 2, another Holovator is out of action. This time, an Alpha Watchog has taken it for its own and refuses to move. Your task is to battle it so that it can be removed once and for all

missions.title: Find My Galarian Stunfisk
missions.description: The requester's Galarian Stunfisk has gone missing. Head to Wild Zone 11 and look for a Stunfisk that's disguised as a Poké Ball.
missions.guide: In South Boulevard by Wild Zone 11, you will find Terri who can't find his Galarian Stunfisk. He will ask for you to find it in the Wild Zone where it will be disguised as a Poké Ball. Find it on the coastline in the southern part of the zone and Terri will appear and say that the Stunfisk has been looking for a new trainer and asks if you would consider being its trainer, so gives it to you.

missions.title: Full Course of Battles: High Rolling
missions.description: Have an exciting experience with spectacular Pokémon battles that only Sushi High Roller can offer! Don't go healing your Pokémon in the middle of things, though
missions.guide: When you go to Sushi High Roller, you will be offered a chance to battle trainers. Normally this costs but to lure you in this will be offered for free. These battles are against Gourmets who send out three Pokémon at once. Defeat all 5 Gourmets to win

missions.title: Delibird Gets in a Flap
missions.description: A Delibird is running around as if in a panic. As it turns out, a wild Garbodor is menacing it...
missions.guide: In Vert Sector 9, a Delibird will come aroun the corner and ask for your help as a Garbodor is chasing it. Defeat the Garbodor and  Delibird will thank you as its trainer appears

missions.title: Some Unusual Pokémon
missions.description: A girl says she has some unusual Pokémon on her team no one else around has, and she wants to show them off in battle. What kind of Pokémon could she have
missions.guide: In Vert Sector 9's Battlefield, Touri will ask if you want to battle as she is using some very unusual Pokémon, specifically Galarian forms of Slowbro and Slowking.

missions.title: Let's Learn About Mega Evolution
missions.description: The kids in the school courtyard want you to teach them all about Mega Evolution. Let the class begin
missions.guide: At the Academie Etoilie, a group of children spot your Mega Ring and ask if they can ask you questions about Mega Evolution. These include what is used to Mega Evolve, the name of the Mega Stone to Mega Evolve Eelektross and which Pokémon changes type upon evolution

missions.title: Catch Mawile If You Can
missions.description: Apparently there is a Mawile that can never be caught, no matter what kind of Poké Ball you use or how many you throw at it.
