missions.guide: In Magenta Sector 3, Réu says that there is a Mawile nearby that cannot be caught, saying he wasted so many Ultra Balls trying. He says if you catch it he will give you some Ultra Balls. Catch the Mawile to surprise him as he leanrns Pokémon only get caught by choice.

missions.title: Inkay's Fragrant Ink
missions.description: The requester says she wants to make a perfume using Inkay ink. What kind of aroma will an ink-based perfume have
missions.guide: At Vernal Avenue, Odette has returned and has asked for you to bring an Inkay so she can use its ink in order to create another perfume. However, she feels the ink may be a bit too tricky for a scent.

missions.title: A Fateful Swing of a Metronome
missions.description: The move Metronome causes a Pokémon to use another random move. It could change the tide of battle...or maybe the Pokémon will just use Splash. Test your fortunes
missions.guide: In Hibernal Avenue, Furiko says she is using the move Metronome to try and see every Pokémon move that there is. She says that you will understand if you battle her so challenges you.

missions.title: A Shocking Territorial Dispute
missions.description: Electric-type Pokémon are having a standoff right in front of a Holovator. It'd be great if they could take their shocking disagreement elsewhere.
missions.guide: In Hibernal Avenue, another Holovator is inaccessible. This time, a Manectric and an Ampharos are arguing in front of it. Battle them and Amordél is shocked at someone settling disputes between Pokémon with Pokémon.

missions.title: Pancham the Courier
missions.description: A familiar Trainer and her partner Pancham seem to be having trouble with a customer. See if you can help them out.
missions.guide: In South Boulevard, you will find Andi, who battled you when you came to the city after stealing your bag, fighting with a sightseer. She says she started a business of helping tourists see the city as they arrive by carrying their bags through but Dolean insists on his Aggron also being carried. Battle him to calm the situation.

missions.title: Clauncher Launching Water Gun
missions.description: The requester wants to make a business out of having his Clauncher wash away sludge around Lumiose using Water Gun. Clauncher, however, seems unenthusiastic.
missions.guide: On a roof in Jaune Sector 8, Nett says he is struggling to get his Clauncher to use Water Gun to help clear some goo so asks for you to use Water Gun on the goo with one of your Pokémon. When you do, it turns out that Clauncher is more interested in breaking rocks

missions.title: Honedge's Cutting Edge
missions.description: The secret to helping a Honedge feel better is to have it battle a Pupitar...? How is that even supposed to work
missions.guide: In North Boulevard, Acier is struggling to get his Honedge to battle well and his father feels that it needs sharpening against a Pupitar. Acier asks if you'd be willing to battle using only a Pupitar. If you do, when defeated it seems Honedge will have energy already and it's back to its old self again.

missions.title: Strike First to Make 'Em Flinch
missions.description: If a Pokémon flinches, it won't be able to use the move it was trying to unleash. Flynn uses moves that are likely to make opponents flinch, and he wants to face you in battle.
missions.guide: In the battlefield by Quasartico Inc., Flynn talks about how if a Pokémon moves first and makes the opponent flinch, it leaves them open to attack. He offers a battle to demonstrate.

missions.title: Follow Litwick
missions.description: The requester says his younger sister has gone missing after following a wild Litwick. Just as you were about to hear his full story, you noticed a Litwick staring at you...
missions.guide: In Magenta Sector 9, a boy, Consei, mentions that his sister has gone missing after following a Litwick and begs for your help as he worries her life force has drained. Follow the Litwick into the Sewers and you will find the girl with the Litwick, but things aren't what it seems at first and you pass out, only to wake up and find multiple Litwick.

missions.title: Who Messed Up the Garden
missions.description: You discovered a large hole in the Rust Syndicate office's garden. Find the true culprit if you don't want to take the blame.
missions.guide: In the Rust Syndicate gardens, some holes have been dug. The Grunt is angry and insists you find out who is responsible. Follow the dug holes to find that a Drilbur did it. The Grunt is annoyed and brings the Drilbur back to fix the mess, which it does. The Grunt is happy and decides to be Drilbur's trainer and bring it into the Rust Syndicate

missions.title: Becoming a Peerless Furfrou Trimmer
missions.description: The requester wants to add even more Furfrou styles to her repertoire. Help out by showing her Scyther yet another move
missions.guide: Return to the Furfrout cutting area in Jaune Sector 6 and Mirte wants to try out some new styles. She asks for you to bring a Pokémon that knows Psycho Cut to help Scyther with its cuts. Use it against the Substitute. This will give inspiration and adds the La Reine, Kabuki and Pharaoh  Trims as possible options

missions.title: The Nervous Novice Cabbie
missions.description: The requester is a taxi driver who's new to the job. She wants you to help her get adjusted by being her first fare.
missions.guide: In Rouge Plaza, you will meet Tesse a Cabbie. She is very nervous as it is her first drive as a cabbie and asks if you would go somewhere with her, for free as it's her first one. She only knows a limited number of places so select Magenta Pokémon Center. She will get lost along the way but eventually gets there. When there, she will ask you for a battle to show that she isn't totally useless.

missions.title: Up, Up, and Away After Emolga
missions.description: A wild Emolga is apparently causing trouble by stealing things from people. Chase after it using Roto-Glide and retrieve the requester's Berries.
missions.guide: In Jaune Sector 7, Urmand will mention that an Emolga has been going around stealing food. While talking to you, the Emolga appears and steals Urmand's food. He asks for you to chase it across the rooftops. When you finally find it, you battle it. Urmand will say you can't blame it as it was just trying to survive

missions.title: Froslass's Unfinished Business
missions.description: A Froslass revealed itself and stared intently at you, as if urging you to follow it.
missions.guide: After defeating Rogue Mega Froslass, when you return to Bleu Sector 3, you will find Froslass in the area. It will get for you to follow it back to where you encountered it when it Mega Evolved. It will then disappear, leaving a Dawn Stone

missions.title: Dragon You into Battle
missions.description: The requester, an SBC member who's particularly fond of Dragon types, wants to have a battle with you. Use type matchups to your advantage.
missions.guide: One of the SBC members, Guivre, is a big fan of Dragon-type Pokémon and can be found in Vert Sector 3. She wants to battle you with her Dragon-type team and her Pokémon are holding Dragon Fangs.

missions.title: The Beldum Blockade
missions.description: Wild Beldum have gathered at a Holovator for some reason, making it so nobody can use it even after it was just repaired...
missions.guide: In South Boulevard, another Holovator is broken down. This one is being blocked by several Beldum. Defeat the Beldum and they will return causing Aimant to think they came here because they like the Holovator. They will then let you past

missions.title: Finding a Place for Heliolisk
missions.description: The requester is looking for a place to share with his Heliolisk. Help him find the perfect spot based on his exacting conditions.
missions.guide:
In South Boulevard, a man at a Café has asked for you to help him find a specific apartment because there are so many ads and he can't decide. He gives his constraints as having to have a view of the tower, be by Saison Canal and have rooftop access for his Heliolisk to sunbath. It also needs to be near a café or Pokémon Center.

With that in mind, there is a building right next to Prism Tower that fits the bill. Go to the rooftop area and Trale will come with his Heliolisk and fall in love with it, putting a request in for accommodation.

missions.title: A Haunting Experience
missions.description: Ghost-type Pokémon are weak to Ghost-type moves. The requester wants to have a battle using only Ghost types to determine who uses them better.
missions.guide: On a roof in Jaune Sector 8, Malé can be found contemplating about Ghost-type Pokémon weaknesses and how speed factors in. She asks for a battle with only Ghost-type Pokémon to decide who is the most superior Ghost-type user. When you win, she fills a chill in the air

missions.title: Let Us Battle...Artistically
missions.description: The requester says she wants to battle “artistically.” How can a battle be artistic? Face her, and maybe you'll find out...
missions.guide: In Rouge Sector 1's Battlefield, Fina wants to have a battle in which she can be artistic. This battle features a team using only Self-Destruct and Explosion.

missions.title: Stop the Runaway Whirlipede
missions.description: The requester wants you to stop his runaway Whirlipede. Chase after the Whirlipede and battle it to get it to stop.
missions.guide: In North Boulevard, Rouland asks for help in a panic as his Whirlipede is running amok and he's concerned it could injure someone so he asks for your help to stop it. When you stop it, a member of the Fists of Justice appears and has a go at Rouland and says he needs to train with them to control his Pokémon better.

missions.title: Jumbo Variety Pumpkaboo
missions.description: It seems that Pumpkaboo come in different varieties that determine their size. The requester wants a Jumbo Variety Pumpkaboo.
missions.guide: In North Boulevard, nearby Wild Zone 15, Taille explains how Pumpkaboo has different forms and they were recently renamed after realising the forms are more different than thought. She has managed to obtained three of them but asks for you to find a Jumbo Variety Pumpkaboo. She insists that you not bring back an Alpha Pumpkaboo. Jumbo Variety Pumpkaboo can only be found at night.

missions.title: Pleasing Aron's Palate
missions.description: Some wild Aron have grown tired of eating the same old scrap metal every day. Maybe you can find some seasoning that will make their meals more appealing
missions.guide: In South Boulevard, a trainer is feeding wild Aron but is worried that the Aron will get bored if they keep being fed the same thing. She asks for you to use a Poison-type move on the scrap metal they're eating, specifically Sludge Bomb. When you use the move, the Aron are happy and they decide to keep trialling different Poison-type moves for the Aron to eat

missions.title: Starmie on High
missions.description: You've been invited to a gathering of people who send messages into space through their Starmie. It would be rude to decline, so join them with a Starmie of your own.
missions.guide: In Magenta Sector 1, Cate will ask if you beamed a message into her brain and decides that you are one of them. She insists you join the next gathering  with people who have a Starmie. Bring a Starmie back at night and you'll participate in the ritual where everyone with a Starmie call down the Starmie in the heaven. Eventually, a shooting star falls in Bleu Sector which contains a Moon Stone that you can pick up later.

missions.title: Steadfast as Steel
missions.description: A Rust Syndicate grunt has challenged you to a battle. She seems to be particularly attached to Steel-type Pokémon.
missions.guide: On Bleu Street, a Rust Syndicate Grunt recognises you and how you helped people so asks for a battle. missions.title: A Chilling Challenge
missions.description: Ice-type moves have a chance of freezing the opponent solid. Beware of Glace's Ice-type Pokémon as you battle her.
missions.guide: In Wild Zone 12, a trainer called Glace will talk about the frozen condition and references her favourite trainer who also uses Ice-type Pokémon. She asks for you to battle her Ice-type Pokémon.

missions.title: Facing the Furfrou League
missions.description: Apparently there is a Furfrou League in Lumiose, complete with Elite Four members all awaiting challengers. Defeat them to become the strongest Furfrou Trainer
missions.guide: After you have unlocked all Furfrou forms, Mirte will inform you of a group of people around Lumiose City who say they are the strongest Furfrou trainers; the Furfrou Elite Four who reside in the four restaurants in the city. She asks that you defeat them in battle but you can only use Furfrou to do so.

missions.title: Abuzz About Bug Types
missions.description: Constance battles using only her favorite type of Pokémon: Bug types. We're at our best when we like what we're working with, so face her with your favorite Pokémon too
missions.guide: In Rouge Sector 7's battlefield, Constance will talk about how her favourite Pokémon are Bug-type Pokémon. She asks for a battle but asks for you to use your favourite Pokémon.

missions.title: Trevenant, the Haunted Elder Tree
missions.description: A certain movie director is making a horror film. He needs a Trevenant for an important scene—lend him one so he can complete his work.
missions.guide: In Rouge Sector 6, by the Cemetery, you will see the Director again. He will say they're doing a horror movie and need a Trevenant for a role. However, when you use your Trevenant for it, it ends up coming across as happy and kind, which causes the Director to rethink the perspective of the scene

missions.title: Klefki's Lost Key
missions.description: The requester's Klefki apparently misplaced a key. The requester let you know where they went on the day it happened, so see if you can hunt down the key based on that info.
missions.guide:
In North Boulevard, you will find Cadena who recognises you as Emma's assistant. She asks for your help to find a key that Klefki dropped. She remembers she went to a Hair Salon that was near a café she had brunch and got challenged to a battle so went to a battle court behind it, but she can't remember specifically where. She asks your help to find the key.

The Battle Court is in Vert Sector 9. If you go there , you will find the Key and Cadena will appear. She will realise Klefki only loses keys it has no attachment to so they agree that Cadena will hold the key this time

missions.title: The World's Greatest Pikachu
missions.description: A Trainer is saying he has the strongest Pikachu—and he wants to prove it. Battle him using a single Pikachu against his, and see whose is mightier
missions.guide: In Rouge Sector 1 you will find Pikami in the battle court. He will say that he has the world's best Pikachu because he has a Light Ball and requests a battle so that he can prove it.

missions.title: Alola, Raichu
missions.description: Alolan Raichu apparently look different from Raichu of other regions. Trade your own Raichu for the requester's Alolan Raichu.
missions.guide:
Next to the Quasartico Inc. building, you will find Griddella. She is a member of the Alolan Raichu awareness club and wants to tell you about the Alolan Raichu. She asks that you battle her.

When you have defeated her, she will offer a trade of an Alolan Raichu for one of your standard Raichu. When you accept, she says she will go catch more Alolan Raichu to spread the word of it.

missions.title: Wondrous Self-Healing Pokémon
missions.description: Pokémon Center clerks are experts at healing Pokémon. For this requester, that apparently extends to having her Pokémon use healing moves in battle.
missions.guide: At Vert Pokémon Center, the Pokémon Center Lady, Bien, says that her specialty is healing Pokémon so she taught her Pokémon moves that can restore HP. She wants to demonstrate and battles you with her team.

missions.title: A Tune That Beckons Doom
missions.description: What did the woman mean when she muttered “in 30 seconds”? If you want to find out, you'll have to face her in battle.
missions.guide: In North Boulevard, Chante will say 30 seconds and say if you wish to know what it means, you have to battle her. She is referring to Perish Song which gives 30 seconds before your Pokémon is knocked out.

missions.title: My Adorable, Adorable Babies
missions.description: In battle, looks can be deceiving. Battle the requester and her formidable Pokémon.
missions.guide: At the Battle Court in Vert Sector 4, Aimée says about how people tend to make judgments based on appearance and wants to battle you with her team to prove that as her Pokémon are very powerful.

missions.title: Exploring the Scents of Spritzee
missions.description: Spritzee's fragrance changes depending on what it eats. The requester wants lots of Berries in order to search for new aromas.
missions.guide: In Magenta Street, by the river, you will find Sente who wants to make an aroma from Spritzee that differs based on the diet it consumes. She asks for you to bring 20 Cheri Berries, 5 Tamato Berries and 5 Occa Berries. When you do, Spritzee complains and indicates that it doesn't want to be used in such a way so rapidly as it'd overwhelm o they decide to look for a former employee of the old Juice Shoppe

missions.title: Bergmite sur un Avalugg
missions.description: The requester wants to put four Bergmite on the back of a giant Avalugg for some photos. You'll need an extra-large Avalugg for that.
missions.guide: In South Boulevard, you will find Brina who has four Bergmite and wants to see them on the back of an Avalugg so asks for you to bring an Avalugg to her that's big enough to fit all four of them, so an XL sized Avalugg. She puts all the Bermite on the back of  the Avalugg and takes photos which start going viral on social media.

missions.title: A Feather from Skarmory
missions.description: The requester wants a Skarmory feather to craft a chef's knife. You should be able to find a Skarmory feather in Wild Zone 17.
missions.guide: At the Coulant Waterway, Couper wants to get a feather from Skarmory that can be used to make a knife. However, the area is filled with angry Pokémon so he asks for your help to get it. The feather can be found on the roof of a building

missions.title: Tyrantrum's Furious Jaws
missions.description: A certain movie director is making a kaiju film. He needs a Tyrantrum for an important scene—lend him one so he can complete his work.
missions.guide: In Autumnal Avenue, you will find the Director again and he says hte movie has changed to become a Kaiju movie so asks for you to bring a Tyrantrum to be in the movie, and you can even be an extra this time. Bring Tyrantrum and it will start roaring but, as soon as it spots you, it calms down and wants to play. This causes the director to change the concept of the movie again to show the bond of humans and Pokémon

missions.title: Show the Power of Aurorus
missions.description: Two children are arguing over which fossil to buy with their pocket money. The girl wants to buy a Sail Fossil, but her brother seems intent on getting a Jaw Fossil.
missions.guide: By the Stone Emporium in Vernal Avenue, you will find two siblings arguing over what fossil to buy. Renc insists Tyrantrum is the best pick but Nage insists Aurorus is better so asks for you to battle him using only an Aurorus. When you win, Renc will relent and will buy the Sail Fossil for Nage so he can battle with his sister so she can prove how strong it is.

missions.title: Josée's Training
missions.description: Josée of the Fist of Justice has requested that you battle her. She seems to have something on her mind—an all-out battle might help clear her head.
missions.guide:
At the Justice Dojo, Josée has asked that you battle her.

When you have defeated her, she will start to question things and thinks she hasn't grown at all since you last battled. However, two Alpha Pangoro soon appear. While Ivor usually deals with them, he is not there so it leaves it to Josée to fight alongside you in a multi-battle against them. Defeat them and Ivor returns and congratulates Josée on a job well done and says he left her in charge of the Dojo because he knew she could protect it.

missions.title: Goodbye Gengar
missions.description: The requester wants you to help him find a Gengar that has gone missing. Perhaps Gwynn can help you, since she is very knowledgeable about Ghost-type Pokémon.
missions.guide:
Location : Bleu Sector 9 (Old House)

In the Old House, you will find Gänger, who you helped out previously clear some ghost Pokémon from his new house. He asks for your help as the Gengar that stayed with him has gone. First, you need to go to Gwynn and she will help you in exchange for a battle.

missions.title: Le Super-Tournoi de Jacinthe O
missions.description: Le Super-Tournoi de Jacinthe is back and even better than before! It will be you against Jacinthe—and ONLY Jacinthe
missions.guide: After you have beaten 20 Ranks in the Z-A Infinite Royale, you will get an invite to a special tournament at Hotel Richissime. This tournament features battles against Jacinthe at every stage of the tournament for a total of four battles. If you are victorious, you earn the right to battle Jacinthe again at any time.

missions.title: Donuts of Unworldly Deliciousness
missions.description: A girl named Ansha suddenly showed up with the Pokémon Hoopa and asked you to help her make a donut. What could be behind this curious request?
missions.guide: If you go to the roof of Hotel Z, you will find a mysterious girl, Ansha. She asks for your help to make a Donut with Hoopa. She is invited to make a space in the kitchen of Hotel Z, but she needs for you to go get some butter. You can find the butter in Magenta Sector 6, but first you need to battle Tarragon and Grisham for it as Tarragon wants it to make Canari Bread. With the butter, return to Hotel Z and you will get taken to Hyperspace Lumiose with Team MZ.

missions.title: A Big Ol' Battle
missions.description: Trevelle once quaked in fear at the sight of an alpha Pokémon, but now he's back and ready for battle himself! Take him on to see the big ol' bonds he's built with his team.
missions.guide: In Rouge Sector 6 you will once again find Trevelle who will say how much he has grown from when he was scared of Alpha Pokémon earlier on. He challenges you to a battle where his team is almost entirely Alpha Pokémon.

missions.title: Let's Golden Goooooo
missions.description: If you have 999 Gimmighoul Coins, then you can evolve Gimmighoul into Gholdengo. Collect enough coins in Hyperspace Lumiose and show the requester a Gholdengo
missions.guide:
In Rouge Sector 1 you will find a man with a Gimmighoul. He will ask your help. He caught the Gimmighoul in Paldea but you need coins to evolve it so asks for your help to find the coins and evolve Gimmighoul. He gives you the Gimmighoul and 413 Coins

If you return with a Gholdengo, he will ask you for the Gholdengo. You have the ability to decline in which he will say he will evolve one on his own, or if you give him a Gholdengo, it will remain there

missions.title: Charging Toward Victory
missions.description: Some moves require a Pokémon to charge up all its strength into one mighty blow. This requester is all about those moves. Battle him and see why
missions.guide: In Vert Sector 4 you will find the trainer Accroi. He tells you about how some moves have charge requirements where you prepare to use them and they then unleash a powerful move. He suggests a battle to demonstrate.

missions.title: Multistrike, Multistrike, Multistrike Moves
missions.description: Wham! Bam! Pow! Multistrike moves hit one after the other. You'll have to deal with the requester's flurries of blows if you want to claim a marvelous victory.
missions.guide: On the roof of the buildings in Amylis Park, you will find Condinu who talks about how great multistrike moves are. She challenges you to a battle so that she can prove it to you.

missions.title: My Hasty Jolteon
missions.description: The requester's Jolteon has a Hasty Nature, and it simply can't wait to battle! Catch up to it and give it the match it's been so eager for.
missions.guide: Alongside Wild Zone 9, you will find the trainer Ohla. He gets ready to ask you for a battle when his Jolteon runs off to the Battle Court immediately as it can't wait to battle. Follow it to the Battle Court and battle them.

missions.title: Cyclizoom
missions.description: The requester and his Cyclizar love moves that make Pokémon move faster. See if you can keep up in a battle of speed.
missions.guide: Alongside South Boulevard, you will find a trainer, Veloce who asks what the most important part of a battle is. He says iti s Speed and asks for a battle to demonstrate, using only his Cyclizer.

missions.title: Mime Jr.'s First Big Job
missions.description: A newly hired Mime Jr. is about to set out on its first big job alone. Look after it-hopefully without being too obvious!-until it reaches the postbox across the bridge.
missions.guide: In Vert Sector 1, a trainer has asked for your help as her Mime Jr. Is off on its first job to collect letters from a postbox. She asks for you to follow the Mime Jr. Do so at a distance  until it gets attacked by Krokorok and Sandile. Defeat them and stick close to Mime Jr. until it reaches its target

missions.title: A Novel Adventure
missions.description: Crivain is writing an adventure novel, but he's struggling to create characters that really leap from the page. He wants you and your Pokémon to serve as his inspiration.
missions.guide: By the Café in Magenta Sector 8 is a man, Crivian, who is trying to think of new characters for a novel and so asks for you to bring him some Pokémon to give him inspiration. He asks for a Ground-type Pokémon, a Pokémon that knows Flamethrower and a Pokémon with a Mega Stone

missions.title: A Work of Great Love
missions.description: Crivain is writing a romance novel, but he's struggling to create characters that really leap from the page. He wants you and your Pokémon to serve as his inspiration.
missions.guide: Return to Crivian and he says he has an idea for a Romance novel and asks for more character inspiration. This time he asks for a Fairy-type Pokémon, a Dragon-type Pokémon and two Alpha Pokémon

missions.title: A Tale of Mystery
missions.description: Crivain is writing a mystery novel, but he's struggling to create characters that really leap from the page. He wants you and your Pokémon to serve as his inspiration.
missions.guide: For his final novel, Crivian requests for Pokémon to help him with a mystery. He asks for a an Alpha Pokémon, a Normal-type Pokémon, a Dark-type Pokémon, a Pokémon that knows Teleport and a Fighting-type Pokémon

missions.title: Rouge District's Utility Hole Covers
missions.description: Do you know which Pokémon is depicted on utility hole covers in the Rouge District? Bring the Pokémon you believe to be the right answer, and show it to the requester.
missions.guide: In South Boulevard, right by Wild Zone 1, you will find a lady, Couver, staring at a utility hole cover. She will say that she calls them Pokémon Lids and ask you a quiz on if you know about them. She asks for you to bring the Pokémon that adorns the Rouge District's PokéLids. Bring a female Pyroar and she will be happy and tell you the meaning of each district's theming with Rouge being Determination.

missions.title: Bitter Blue Flames vs. Blazing Crimson
missions.description: Two rivals meet on a fateful field of battle. Armarouge and Ceruledge must face their destinies and see who emerges the victor! Think you can give Adver his dream battle?
missions.guide: In Vert Sector 6, you will find Adver. Adver is very desiring in a rival as he wants to act out a massive childhood rivalry, but has never had one himself. He asks for you to bring a Charcadet and evolve it so he can use the other one in a battle. Pick between the two  and he will then evolve his Charcadet. Follow his story and battle him.

missions.title: Farfetch'd Ambush!
missions.description: There's a rumor that if you walk down a certain street at night with just a Farfetch'd holding a Leek, you'll be ambushed. Lure out the culprit or culprits and punish them!
missions.guide:
At the Berry stall in Jaune Street, the vendor will talk to you about a rumour of an ambush happening in Rouge Sector 7. It is said if you take a Farfetch'd holding a leek to the area at night, you will get ambushed. He gives you the leek and asks you to investigate.

When you arrive there, you start to get ambushed by trainers with Farfetch'd.

Pokémon Trainer Chevalier Farfetch'd Battle Type Items Level 80 Attacks : Swords Dance Feather Dance Slash Aerial Ace Hold Item : No Item 3514 Pokémon Trainer Louie Farfetch'd Battle Type Items Level 84 Attacks : Dual Wingbeat Slash Feather Dance Aerial Ace Hold Item : No Item 3515 Pokémon Trainer Bouché Farfetch'd Battle Type Items Level 89 Attacks : Dual Wingbeat Focus Energy Slash Night Slash Hold Item : Leek After defeating them, they will return and thank you for joining in. They wanted to re-enact their favourite scenes from a movie and you played a solid part in it.

After defeating them, they will return and thank you for joining in. They wanted to re-enact their favourite scenes from a movie and you played a solid part in it.

missions.title: Squawking, Squabbling Squawkabilly!
missions.description: A group of four squabbling Squawkabilly are squawking up a storm, and folks nearby just want them to scram! So help stop their squabbling with a show of strength!
missions.guide: In Jaune District, a man will scream that some Squawkabilliy are causing a commotion nearby that is annoying everyone and asks you to put a stop to it. Climb to the top of the building and battle all four Squawkabilly to calm them down

missions.title: Cubone's Survey
missions.description: You spotted a Cubone standing alone-it was actually helping with a street survey! No amount of saying no could get you out of it, so you did your best to answer the survey.
missions.guide: In Hibernal Avenue, you will find a Cubone on the ground. When you approach it, you will get asked to participate in a survey. The survey is all about the item, Protein and its effect and how much you think you should spend on it.

missions.title: Fidough Loves Walks
missions.description: The baker, Promme, has asked you to take her Fidough for a walk. Take a stroll with Fidough along their usual route.
missions.guide: In Jaune Street, Promme has asked for you to take her Fidough out on a walk as she's too busy to do it. This is done by walking around Wild Zone 19 in a loop before getting back. However, there are several obstacles on the path such as a Maschiff that is off-lead and runs up, but just wants to play and then playing with some local children before looping back

missions.title: Fungi-ble Goods
missions.description: Bene, who works at a Pokémon Center, has asked you to bring her a Foongus. She says its resemblance to a Poké Ball will help drum up sales.
missions.guide: In the Hibernal Pokémon Center, Bene will mention how her Pokémon Center is the lowest rated one in the city for selling Poké Balls. She will ask for your help in regards to this so asks for you to give her a Foongus to act as a mascot. Return with the Foongus and she will keep it on the desk with her.

missions.title: Octolock Away the Pain!
missions.description: The requester can't even stand, due to the pain from his bad back. Will the Pokémon move Octolock really make it better? Save this poor fellow from his spinal suffering!
missions.guide: In the underground path in Bleu Sector 4, you will find a man who is hunched over in pain as he threw his back out. He thinks the best way to solve it, one that has been done before, is for a Grapploct to use Octolock on it. Return with one and use the move on him and it will sort his back out. He will thank you for your help

missions.title: The Dauntless Raichu Duo
missions.description: Two of your former trade partners have joined forces and are seeking the chance to battle you! Try to seize victory against their two dauntless Raichu in one battle!
missions.guide: In Hyperspace Lumiose, you wqill get a Side Mission where the two trainers, Tracie and Griddella that you traded Raichu with before will appear and battle you together. Using Hyperspace, they turn their Raichu into Alphas and battle you each with the Raichu Mega Stones. Defeat them to get the Mega Stones

missions.title: A Message from Across Dimensions
missions.description: You've been entrusted with a letter by a man you met in hyperspace. He says that it must be delivered to Académie étoile's director...
missions.guide:
In a Side Mission within Hyperspace Lumiose, you will find a man sitting on a bench who gives you an Important Letter. Take this important Letter to Moire at the Academie Etoile. She remembrs that you helped find her ring before and asks where you got the letter. She says she needs to go to Racine Construction instantly.

Go with her and she will tell you that the letter said that the letter is from her departed husband who said that he left his ring with Tarragon. She asks if Tarragon remembers this, and he does and provides the ring as he was to repair it after he met her husband at a restaurant. He gives the ring back but insists on a battle with you first.

missions.title: Rogue Mega Showdown
missions.description: Two Mega Crabominable are fighting in Hyperspace Lumiose. In other words, it's a Rogue Mega Showdown! Break up the fight before things get out of hand.
missions.guide:
In a Hyperspace Lumiose mission, a man will rush up to you and say two Pokémon are fighting. Two Alpha Crabominable have Rogue Mega Evolved and you need to battle and defeat them both.

When both have been defeated, you will get the Crabominite Mega Stone

missions.title: That's Some Nacli Coffee
missions.description: How strange-the coffee at Café Introversion is coming out salty! You also spotted a suspicious Pokémon on the roof. What's really going on here?
missions.guide:
At Café Introversion, a customer says their coffee has got incredibly salty, which is the opposite of what the café sells so you are asked to investigate. On the roof is a Nacli which runs off. You have to chase after it and catch it then bring it back to the restuarant.

After explaining the situation, the customer then says that the coffee has grown on her and suggests the café keeps it.

missions.title: Which Meowth Do You Purrfer
missions.description: Felina says that she'll let you choose one of three different-looking Meowth as a special reward if you can beat her in a battle.
missions.guide:
In Rouge Sector 7, you will find Felina playing with three Meowth. She says that you can have some time with one of the Meowth but you need to first defeat her and her Meowth in a battle.

After defeatiing the Meowth, she will ask for you to pick one of the three which lets you play and pet them before you leave.

missions.title: Imitation Is the Sincerest Form of Flattery
missions.description: A passionate Canatic wants to reproduce a photo of Canari chillin' on a bench. Help the fan find the bench to complete her quest!
missions.guide: In Magenta Sector 1, a fan of Canari asks for your help. She saw a picture Canari posted on social media and she wants to replicate it, so she asks for you to find the bench the picture was taken from. The bench is on the roof of a nearby building. After you have found it, Sasse will then ask for your help taking the picture. She insists it be done from the exact same angle of Canari's picture.

missions.title: My Neighbor Tinkatuff
missions.description: The requester has a new neighbor, who just moved to Lumiose from another region. He's feeling a bit uneasy dealing with this stranger, so help play go-between for him.
missions.guide: In Jaune Setor 6, Acier has a problem. He says a new neighbour moved in recently and their Pokémon is intimidating his Scizor, who is extremely shy. He asks for you to approach the new neighbour and ask what the problem is. Climb the roof and you will find Herrera and her Tinkatuff. She will say that her Pokémon has been staring at the Scizor because it is scared itself. There's a back and forth between the two until they finally decide the best thing to do is have the Pokémon meet, and the problem is resolved

missions.title: Terror in the Sands
missions.description: The Pokémon living in Wild Zone 8 are behaving oddly, and now you've been tasked with having a look around to see if you can find out the cause.
missions.guide: By Wild Zone 8, Enqué will mention that the Pokémon in Wild Zone 8 have started to act timid and avoid the sand. She asks for your help in investigating the issue. When you approach the sand, five Sandygast will appear and attack you at once. Defeat or catch them and the situation will be resolved and Wild Zone 8's Pokémon will return back to normal

missions.title: Our Gluttonous Gulpin
missions.description: A Gulpin appeared at Hotel Z out of nowhere, probably lured in by the delicious smell of all the donuts. Try feeding it one to satisfy its hunger!
missions.guide: In Hotel Z, the Gulpin that one day arrived is starting to act hungry. Ansha speculates that Lida was right in that Gulpin came due to the aroma of the Donuts and recommends you feed it a donut. If you feed it a donut, you will get a berry in return. After the mission is complete, you can continue feeding the Gulpin a donut to get a berry

missions.title: A Sorta Scary Cemetery Story
missions.description: Horace told you about a strange rumor: A gravestone in the Dormez Bien Cemetery moves around night after night under certain conditions. Go see if it's true!
missions.guide:
When you find Horace in North Boulevard, he will mention that a story has spread amongst couriers that graves will move around at night in the Dormez Bien Cemetery and asks for you to investigate. He notes that there are four conditions: It has to be night, you have one Pokémon with you and you have to enter from the north gate wit the words "Solitary solo cemeteries are sorta scary." in your head.

Go to the cemetery and you will find several Greavard and a Houndstone in the area. Defeat them and Horace will run to the area and be relieved about the story not being entirely true.

missions.title: Scovillain's Spice-Off
missions.description: One of the staff at Restaurant Le Yeah is planning a special event focused on spicy dishes. Help make it a rousing success with Scovillain's Spicy Extract move!
missions.guide:
At Restaurant Le Yeah, Armie has asked for your help. He feels that the dishes at the restaurant could use some spice to help the restaurant go beyond 2 Stars. He asks for you to bring a Scovillain that knows Spicy Extract so that he can hold a Spice Fiesta.

Bring the Scovillain and you will go in the restaurant and you need to use Spicy Extract on every table in the restaurant so people can enjoy the spicy dishes. Armie is thrilled with how happy people are and thanks you for your help

missions.title: Corvisquire's Search
missions.description: A Corvisquire has flown all the way across the sea from far-off Galar to reach Lumiose, in search of someone. But the only clue you've got is a single scarf...
missions.guide:
In Bleu Sector, a Police Officer asks for your help as the Corvisquire is carrying a Dirty Scarf that's dear to it, and concludes that Corvisquire is looking for the owner of it. He notes the scarf has the name Destin on it, which  causes Corvisquire to react. You call Naveen or Lida to ask for help and they recommend going to Asami at Boutique Couture as she may be able help.

Find Asami and she will note that the scarf is one given to new students at a school in Wyndon so recommends going to Academie Etoile to see if they have transferred to that school

missions.title: Hyperspatial Scuffle vs. DYN4MO
missions.description: You ran into DYN4MO's Canari and Tarragon in Hyperspace Lumiose-and now you've somehow gotten dragged into a two-on-two battle! Seize victory together with Naveen
missions.guide:
In Hyperspace Lumiose, you will find Canari and Tarragon who are spending time in Hyperspace Lumiose. However, Naveen appears and says that he wants to talk to Canari and wants to prove his worth by battling, so you battle both of them.

Defeat them for Canari's Tracksuit set

missions.title: Hyperspatial Scuffle vs. the Fist of Justice
missions.description: You ran into the Fist of Justice's Ivor and Gwynn in Hyperspace Lumiose-and now you've gotten dragged into a two-on-two battle! Seize victory together with Korrina
missions.guide: In Hyperspace Lumiose, you will find Ivor and Gwynn who think the place looks familiar. Korrina will arrive and ask to battle as she wants to battle every Mega Evolution.

missions.title: Hyperspatial Scuffle vs. the Rust Syndicate
missions.description: You ran into the Rust Syndicate's Corbeau and Philippe in Hyperspace Lumiose-and you've gotten dragged into a two-on-two battle! Seize victory together with Taunie/Urbain
missions.guide:
In Hyperspace Lumiose, you will find a pocket akin to the Old House and Corbeau & Phillipe can be found. Taunie/Urbain appear and thank Corbeau for clearing a debt. Corbeau decides to battle.

Defeat them to get Corbeau's Suit & Tie set

missions.title: Hyperspatial Scuffle vs. the SBC
missions.description: You ran into the SBC's Jacinthe and Lebanne in Hyperspace Lumiose-and you've gotten dragged into a two-on-two battle! Seize victory together with Lida
missions.guide:
In Hyperspace Lumiose, you will find Jacinthe and Lebanne, and Jacinthe immediately challenges you. Lida appears and says the numbers aren't fair so decides to join you for the battle.

Defeat them and Jacinthe praises Lida's dancing skills and Lida offers to help her learn. You receive Jacinthe's dress

missions.title: Hyperspatial Scuffle vs. Team Flare Nouveau
missions.description: You ran into Team Flare Nouveau's Grisham and Griselle in Hyperspace Lumiose-and you've gotten dragged into a two-on-two battle! Seize victory together with Emma
missions.guide:
In Hyperspace Lumiose, you find Grisham and Griselle who question why they are there. Emma soon appears and challenges them to a battle.

Defeat them and Emma wll ask them about why Xerosic was working for Team Flare to get a grip on what her old mentor was like. Grisham then gives you his Chef Top Set

missions.title: A Special Seviper
missions.description: The requester is proud of his Seviper-a rare catch in Lumiose City. But the Pokémon beside him is 100 percent an Arbok. Can you catch and show him a real Seviper
missions.guide:
In Jaune Street, Erpen is showing off his Arbok which he says is a rare catch because it's a Seviper. He won't listen to you correcting him saying it's an Arbok so he asks for you to bring a real Seviper.

Bring him a Seviper and he refuses to relent, thinking he got Seviper's Regional Form until he eventually realises the truth

missions.title: What's Wafting from Wigglytuff
missions.description: The requester's Wigglytuff hates showers. It gets enraged if Bain tries to wash it, so he wants you to pretend to battle him so you can hit Wigglytuff with a good Bubble Beam
missions.guide: In Bleu Sector 9, you will find Bain who starts talking about Wigglytuff's fur and how sublime it is, but complains that his Wigglytuff isn't like that as it stinks, yet it hates shower. So he requests a battle with you using a Pokémon that knows Bubble Beam, asking you to use Bubble Beam on the Wigglytuff.

missions.title: The Trainer Tipster
missions.description: Avise, who puts up Trainer Tips around town, wants to craft new helpful tips to share. Share some wisdom with him-for the public good
missions.guide: In Bleu District, you will find Avise who works for the Trainer Tips boards creators. He is thinking about new Trainer Rtip boards to put up around Lumiose City pertaining to Hyperspace Lumiose and asks you a few questions about the scenarios you find there

missions.title: Who Nicked That Snack
missions.description: The requester had just given her Toxel a treat and looked away for a moment-and then the snack disappeared! Where did it go? Help track down that treat
missions.guide: Calin has recently given her Toxel a snack but Toxel has begun crying as the treat is gone. Knowing Toxel savors its treats, tt seems something has stolen its snack. A Nickit soon arrives with the snack and Calin asks for you to chase it. Chase it and catch it and you will resolve the situation. Both Pokémon are given snacks

missions.title: Feebas's New Friends
missions.description: Feebas is categorized as a Fish Pokémon, just like Magikarp, right? So the requester wants a Feebas of her own as well.
missions.guide:
Soucian has mentioned how both Magikarp and Feebas have the same category and queries why you can't see Feebas in the rivers of Lumiose City. She asks for you to catch a Feebas and give it to her.

After you give her a Feebas, she thinks things will go well there. From here on, Feebas will spawn in the wild at this point

missions.title: Frigibax's Friend-Finding
missions.description: The requester wants to find friends for her Frigibax, but she can't bring herself to talk to people. Talk to the Trainers in Wild Zone 10 for her.
missions.guide:
In Wild Zone 9, you will meet Modesta who is a bit timid with social situations but thinks her Frigibax needs friends. She asks for you to look around Wild Zone 9 for other Pokémon that Frigibax can be friends with. Explore the area and you will find a trainer with Bergmite, a trainer with Torchic and a trainer with Zangoose. All of them are happy for Bergmite to be friends with their Pokémon.

Return to Modesta with the good news and she will hank you but thinks the Pokémon aren't suitable for Frigibax. However, after the mission completes, Frigibax has a go at her and the three trainers arrive telling her it's ok so she eventually relents for Frigibax's sake

missions.title: Maybe Morpeko Guards
missions.description: Since Quasartico's guard Dedenne were defeated, some at the company are thinking about finding new guard Pokémon. Help test whether Morpeko might be up to the task.
missions.guide:
Outside of Quasartico Inc., Solu will say that due to the incident earlier when you defeated the two Dedenne guards, there has been talk about replacing them. She asks for you to battle the potential replacements, Morpeko.

Defeat them and they will turn into Hangry Mode which has them give in to their darker instinct so Solu determines they're not viable guards

missions.title: Help Us Pick a Name
missions.description: This unremarkable street needs a name that will really make people remember it. Put an end to this trio's endless debate once and for all by picking a candidate for them.
missions.guide: In Magenta Sector 8, three people are discussing the road and suggesting they change its name. They ask for your opinion between Lumiose Grand Avenue, Mega Evolution Road or Borevard Boulevard. You can accept any of these ideas or you can suggest your own. Whichever you decide will be accepted.

missions.title: Kiosk Conundrum
missions.description: The requester wants you to look after her kiosk in the Magenta District while she's gone. Listen carefully to customers' orders and make sure you charge the correct price.
missions.guide:
At the news stand in North Boulevard, Pegola asks for your help as she needs you to cover on the stand in order to run an errand. She gives you the prices of the four items they sell and asks for you to get everything perfect as people come through.

The first person asks for three bottles of Fresh Water and one Moomoo Milk which is 1,200 The second has you  go for a Lemonade and a Soda Pop which will be 700 The third asks for 3 Soda Pop, 1 Lemonade and a Moomoo Milk for 1,900 A grumpig arrives with 1000 and wants to spend its money on two items so offer a Lemonade anda  Moomoo Milk. If you get it wrong, it will use Psychic Finally,  duo ask for 65 Fresh water, 23 Soda Pop, 28 Lemonade and 31 Moomoo Milk which comes to 49,700.

However you do you will complete the mission and will get a tip for your time based on how well you did

missions.title: The Lumiose Museum Heist
missions.description: A robber has targeted the Lumiose Museum! Or that's the premise of Officer Licier's police training scenario, anyway. Think you're up to playing the thief and stealing an exhibit
missions.guide:
Outside Lumiose Museum, the Police Officer that stopped you with Goomy before comes to apologise for what happened before and has come to ask for your help. The officers are testing out a heist on the museum to see where security needs to be tightened and asks for you to break in and steal Volo's outfit on display. You have to move through and battle all the Police Officers to get to it

Defeat all three and get the outfit and they will  say it's great practice and the officers recommend not using such a strong trainer

missions.title: The Joy of Mimicry
missions.description: Mike the master mimic and his partner, Mr. Rime, are hard at work on their act. Get a load of their mimicry chops through- what else?-a Pokémon battle.
missions.guide: In Vert Sector 3, Mike is practicing his mimicry with his Mr. Rime and asks for you to battle, with him using the move Mimic.

missions.title: Porygon's Polygon Count
missions.description: A game developer named Trian wants to tell you all about polygons. He hopes to illustrate the concept in a fun way, if you'll only agree to trade Porygon with him.
missions.guide:
In Bleu Sector 6, you will find Trian who is an Indie Game Developer. He discusses the changes in video game development with you, specifically in regards to Porygon and wants to demonstrate so suggests doing a Porygon for Porygon trade. His Porygon will be sent holding an Upgrade so it will automatically evolve Alias Level 64 OT: Trian ID: 065536 Hold Item: Upgrade Modest Nature. Date of Receiving a link trade. Met at Lv. 50 Self-Destruct Discharge Metal Sound Recover After the trade, you will be able to find a Hyperspace Portal that will bring you to the Old House where Trian is again, and he will give you a Dubious Disc to evolve Alias even further.

After the trade, you will be able to find a Hyperspace Portal that will bring you to the Old House where Trian is again, and he will give you a Dubious Disc to evolve Alias even further.

missions.title: Reve de Musharna
missions.description: “Welcome to Rêve de Musharna! We offer a very special service for those plagued with bad dreams, so stop on by and allow us to ease you into a restful sleep at once!”
missions.guide: In Rouge Sector 5 by the Looker Bureau you will find Noda. They run a business venture to help Pokémon suffering from bad dreams catch up on their sleep, but the first customer's Flamigo won't fall asleep. As it's their first customer, they think Musharna is suffering from jitters so asks for you to use Hypnosis then Dream Eater on Flamigo. Return and Flamigo gets some good sleep.

missions.title: A Gallant Indeedee
missions.description: Manny at Café Gallant is looking for a gallant Pokémon to help out with his work. Help him get the Indeedee of his dreams.
missions.guide: At Café Gallant, Manny is looking for help to make the best Lumiose Galette and so asks for your help as they need a Gallant Pokémon to help so ask for an Indeedee. Bring an Indeedee to him and he will get to work on making the Lumiose Galettes

missions.title: Rotom Showcase
missions.description: A Pokémon called Rotom infiltrates appliances and electronic devices and changes into various forms. The requester will showcase all the forms for you
missions.guide: In Magenta Sector 9, on the roof you will find Lyons and his partner who want to discuss Rotom and how it inhabits applianaces. They want to show you the Rotom in its forms so offer a battle. Battle all five forms to get the Rotom Catalog.

missions.title: Awaken, Cofagrigus
missions.description: Screams echo eerily from a sewer in the Saison Canalside area. A brave and definitely not scared Rust Syndicate grunt requested a hand investigating this phenomenon.
missions.guide: By the entrance to the sewers in Saison Canal, a Rust Syndicate Grunt will say that he heard screams coming from the sewers. If you go inside, you will find that some Cofagrigus are resting in there. Having been known to take people and put them inside their coffins, your task is to attack the Cofagrigus and clear them out. There are several through the area including near the roof. Once all have been cleared, the finla one will release a man who got excited at seeing them and angered them.

missions.title: Sawk vs. Throh
missions.description: Looks like you'll be the deciding fighter in this Sawk-versus-Throh fandom war. Join one of the two teams and prepare to grapple for victory!
missions.guide:
In the Justice Dojo, you interrupt a skirmish between two big fans of Throh and Sawk. Each insists that their favourite is supreme and asks for you to decide between them. Return with either a Throh or a Sawk and you will enter in a large battle between them. It starts as a draw from the 4 battles before it leading it down to you.

Defeat them and the other will start to see the benefits of the other and the dispute is resolved

missions.title: Be a Defenseless Dodger
missions.description: Canari's come up with an ultra-hardcore game: the Defenseless Dodger challenge! Dodge wild Pokémon's attacks for as long as you can-no catching or fighting back!
missions.guide:
Canari has a challenge for you. She has set up a Defenseless Dodger game where you have to avoid being knocked out for 30 seconds. You cannot use Pokémon and so have to dodge the attacks and not be knocked out. Survive for 30 seconds to complete the mission and get a title.

This can be redone again at any time

missions.title: I Still Remember the Taste...
missions.description: The requester has returned to Lumiose after a long time away. He still remembers the fine coffee he had at Lysandre Café years ago, but is there a way he could enjoy it once more?
missions.guide:
In Magenta Sector 2, a man has come to Lysandre Café who came here 10 years ago. He remembers the coffee there and wants to experience it again so asks for your help. You call Grisham and he suggests going to their No. 3 truck as the barista working there used to work under the barista of the café. Go there and  she will be excited and says her mentor will be pleased that someone remembers his coffee. She says she will get him and to go to Lysandre Café.

When there, you get introduced to the old barista but he says he's out of practice as he used to use Pokémon moves to roast the beans, and asks for a battle.

Defeat them and the coffee is made and Dixan is thrilled and says it's better than he remembers it. Mait mrentions that it was in fact Trois who made it this time Coffee Aficionados Trois Liepard Flareon Battle Type Items Level 75 Level 80 Attacks : Fake Out Torment Play Rough Attacks : Flame Wheel Fire Spin Fire Fang Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item Coffee Aficionados Maît Scrafty Houndoom Battle Type Items Level 76 Level 80 Attacks : Drain Punch Fire Punch Attacks : Flamethrower Crunch Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item

missions.title: Romance avec Purrloin
missions.description: The requester's going on a first date, and he wants to tell the lucky lady how he feels about her...but he's got the jitters! Help him keep the conversation afloat.
missions.guide: Frousse has a problem. He is going on a first date with someone and is very nervous and doesn't know what to talk about. He knows she likes Purrloin so got a Purrloin but doesn't know too much about it so asks you to be near on his date and help answer questions about Purrloin for him so he can impress the date.

missions.title: Ultimate Beans of Supreme Ultimacy
missions.description: The barista at Café Ultimo has managed to obtain the ultimate beans of supreme ultimacy-the best coffee beans in existence. But the price is as astounding as the flavor.
missions.guide: At Café Ultimo, Brula has obtained beans to make the best coffee ever and asks you if you want it. She charges 1,000,000 for it and questions you at every turn if you want to accept it and she will then create the coffee for you.

missions.title: Triste Dreams of Tatsugiri
missions.description: The waitress at Café Triste insists that they need to serve sushi. She wants you to show her Tatsugiri-sushi-like Pokémon-in hopes that if she sees them, she can make sushi.
missions.guide: Triste wants to improve sales at the café and is trying to come up with ideas and one of the ideas is sushi to go with the coffee so she asks for you to bring all three forms of Tatsugiri to her. Getting inspiration, she makes sushi to go with the coffee. She takes a shot and offers you sushi wwith your coffee. A passerby notices and is stunned and puts it on social media. It becomes a viral sensation and customers flock to the café

missions.title: Dondozo Down in the Dumps
missions.description: It sounds like a large Pokémon is stuck in a pipe in the sewer. Better rescue the stuck Pokémon before anything bursts and floods!
missions.guide: In Lumiose Sewers, a workman asks for your help as a big Pokémon is blocking a pipe so needs your help. Investigate in the sewers and you will find a pipe with an Alpha Dondozo in. Attack the Dondozo and it will pop out, but then challenge you. Defeat it and Honcho will be surprised having never seen one and ask it if it wants to be his partner Pokémon

missions.title: A Sub-30-Second Loss
missions.description: The requester is bursting with confidence that his Palossand can take some serious hits. Why don't you see if you can make him accept a loss in 30 seconds or less?
missions.guide: In Magenta Sector 6, Trent has confidence in his battle skills and challenges you to take down his Palossand in 30 seconds for him to accept that you have skill. He is surprised when you beat his challenge.

missions.title: A Wild Rosebud
missions.description: The requester has a carefree Pokémon named Rosebud that wanders off a lot. This time, it strayed into Wild Zone 6. Bring it back to the requester.
missions.guide:
By Wild Zone 6, Adoré mentions that her Pokémon, Rosebud is in the Wild Zone but she is too concerned to go in and find it herself. She asks for you to go in and find Rosebud, saying that it should be obvious what Pokémon it is so investigate the Pokémon within.

On the roof of a building is an Alpha Annihilape, which is Rosebud. Challenge it to a battle and defeat it, and Adoré says it shouldn't run off as it will scare people.

missions.title: Hyperspatial Slugfest vs. DYN4MO
missions.description: You ran into DYN4MO's Canari and Tarragon in Hyperspace Lumiose again-meaning it's time for another two-on-two battle! Seize victory together with Gwynn!
missions.guide: In Hyperspace Lumiose, you will find the Canari hologram. Gwynn appears and has a go at Tarragon for misrepresenting Canari and Tarragon appears. Gwynn is angry saying Canari doesn't need bandwagoners and Canari appears saying she doesn't like them arguing so suggests a battle DYN4MO's Canari Ampharos Stunfisk Eelektross Battle Type Items Level 60 Level 60 Level 60 Attacks : Ice Punch Thunder Attacks : Discharge Sludge Wave Attacks : Zap Cannon Giga Drain Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : Eelektrossite DYN4MO's Tarragon Hippowdon Stunfisk Excadrill Battle Type Items Level 60 Level 60 Level 60 Attacks : Heavy Slam Earthquake Attacks : Earth Power Sludge Bomb Attacks : Iron Head Drill Run Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : Excadrite Fist of Justice Gwynn Banette Gourgeist Chandelure Battle Type Items Level 90 Level 90 Level 94

missions.title: Hyperspatial Slugfest vs. the Fist of Justice
missions.description: You ran into the Fist of Justice's Ivor and Gwynn in Hyperspace Lumiose again- meaning it's time for another two-on-two battle! Seize victory together with Lebanne!
missions.guide: In Hyperspace Lumiose, Ivor and Lebanne are arguing about why Lebanne wants strength. She mentions how she wants to beat Jacinthe so she'll never lose to anyone again. Gwynn asks for you to join in to settle the squabble

missions.title: Hyperspatial Slugfest vs. the Rust Syndicate
missions.description: You ran into the Rust Syndicate's Corbeau and Philippe in Hyperspace Lumiose again- meaning it's time for another two-on-two battle! Seize victory together with Vinnie!
missions.guide: In Hyperspace Lumiose, you will find Philippe and Corbeau talking with Vinnie where they say Quasartico Inc. isn't paying their fair share for Hyperspcae Surveys. Vinnie says they paid the agreed amount but Corbeau says the incrase in distortions requires a rethink of it. They decide to settle it with a battle.

missions.title: Hyperspatial Slugfest vs. the SBC
missions.description: You ran into the SBC's Jacinthe and Lebanne in Hyperspace Lumiose again- meaning it's time for another two-on-two battle! Seize victory together with...Jacinthe?
missions.guide: In Hyperspace Lumiose, Lebanne is lamenting about Jacinthe when Jacinthe appears and overhears so questions what Lebanne means. She pushes further and suggests a battle is in order. Jacinthe says she will team with you while Lebanne teams with Jacinthe's hologram.

missions.title: Hyperspatial Slugfest vs. Team Flare Nouveau
missions.description: You ran into Team Flare Nouveau's Grisham and Griselle in Hyperspace Lumiose again- meaning it's time for another two-on-two battle! Seize victory together with Philippe!
missions.guide: In Hyperspace Lumiose, Grisham and Griselle are talking to Philippe where they learn about how he was trained under one of Lumiose's top chefs. They recommend a battle to help them become hungry to learn about the food more.

missions.title: The Ultimate Techniques
missions.description: You'll need to overcome three tough trials using only a Meganium, an Emboar, and a Feraligatr respectively if you want to learn the requester's "ultimate moves."
missions.guide: By the Café in Wild Zone 6 is Arcannes. She suggests battling to learn the Ultimate moves, but with a twist. She requests you battle her Fire team with only Meganium, her Water team with only Emboar and her Grass team with only Feraligatr. Defeat each of the teams to get the TMs for Frenzy Plant, Blast Burn and Hydro Cannon.

missions.title: The Dauntless Dragalge Trainer
missions.description: You met Marcia, who seems to be searching far and wide for a Trainer she once battled. This Trainer apparently uses a Dragalge. Could they be somewhere in Lumiose?
missions.guide: By the train station is a Black Belt called Marcia. She asks for your help in finding someone she used to know who is tall with green hair but dresses as a treet fighter. Go to Hotel Richissime and go to Lebanne and Marcia will appear, surprised at what she is wearing and challenges Lebanne to a battle. Jacinthe says she can't join in a battle without her so you have to battle both of them.

missions.title: Start Special Scanning
missions.description: You got a call from Corbeau about this new “special scan” system. Sounds interesting... Head to Corbeau's office to hear more.
missions.guide:
After catching Rayquaza, you will get a call from Corbeau who says they are working on a form of Special Scanning. This allows for them to pinpoint rare portals into Hyperspace Lumiose. Your task is to obtain 25,000 points in Hyperspace Surveys in order to get enough power to run the scan.

Return after collecting the points and the first scan will run offering a 5 Star area at random. From here, you will be able to get new scans every 25,000 Points

missions.title: Siblings of the Sky
missions.description: The siblings you met in hyperspace had the Legendary Pokémon Latios and Latias with them. Accept their request to battle you.
missions.guide:
Location : Rouge Sector 8 (North Boulevard Shopping Center)

In a 5 Star Hyperspace Side Mission portal, you will be taken to an area reminiscent of Sky Pillar where two unusual siblings will appear. They will ask if you are aware of Latios & Latias and then challenge you to a battle> Defeat them for the Mega Stones.

missions.title: A Mimikyu for My Cutie
missions.description: Vinnie is in a spot of trouble. His young daughter is begging for a Mimikyu, but that Pokémon isn't usually found in the Kalos region. Help catch one for him.
missions.guide: In the Quasartico Inc. building, Vinnie can be found asking for your help. He is looking for a Pokémon for his daughter, for whom he cares. She desires the Mimikyu but says if he doesn't give her one, she'll request the hair tie she made for him back. Return with a Mimikyu and he will mention he hopes that his daughter will challenge him one day as a tainer

missions.title: Collecting Four Drives
missions.description: The requester is willing to trade you four one-of-a-kind drives in exchange for Mega Shards. Collect all four, and he'll share some special information with you.
missions.guide:
Location : Jaune Sector (Next to WZ17

Near Wild Zone 17, you will find the man who exchanges Mega Shards for TMs. He will now ask you if you have heard of the Pokémon, Genesect. He has some intel on its location but will only give it to you if you buy all four drives for Genesect off of him.

When you have  all four, talk to him and he will mention about going to a wall in Wild Zone 13. When there, a portal will appear. Go inside the portal and you can find the Pokémon, Genesect. Genesect Level 60 OT: Yours ID: Yours Hold Item: None Timid Nature. Date of Receiving Hyperspace Lumiose. Met at Lv. 60 Techno Blast Lunge Flash Cannon Bug Buzz

missions.title: The Stealthy Shadow
missions.description: The requester wants you to check if a rumor being spread by an occult-focused account is true. Follow the instructions and see if the ghostly child is for real
missions.guide:
In South Boulevard, north of Wild Zone 6, you will find Gardie, a member of the  Lumiose Safety Group. He apologises for his prior actions but asks for your help with a task. An online account called Hex Maniac Channel has made a claim about a ghost child appearing in the city and asks for your help.

He gives you the tip of “At the hour when the grandest shadow's tip pierces the center of the circle of red and white...  “they who dare thrust their fist toward the earth may find a ghostly child creeping near.  “Is this true? Find out for yourself, if you dare... Truth is in the eye of the beholder.” and asks you to investigate. This takes you to Rouge Sector 1's  Battle Court. As the day turns to evening, Prism Tower's shadow will reach it. If you interact with it when the shadow is touching it, Marshadow will appear and attack, ready to be captured. Marshadow Level 80 OT: Yours ID: Yours Hold Item: None ?? Nature. Date of Receiving Rogue Sector 1. Met at Lv. 80 Spectral Thief Shadow Punch Close Combat Shadow Sneak

missions.title: Dreams of Meltan
missions.description: A strange, not often seen Pokémon appeared near the entrance to a bank. The requester wants you to catch it so it doesn't bother the customers.
missions.guide: In Rouge Sector 1 by the bank, a woman will say that she has found a Pokémon she's never seen before and doesn't know what to make of it. She points it out to you, a Meltan, and asks if you could catch it as chasing it off could mean it'd come back. Challenge it and capture it Meltan Level 70 OT: Yours ID: Yours Hold Item: None Any Nature. Date of Receiving Rouge Sector 1. Met at Lv. 70 Flash Cannon Brutal Swing Acid Armor Thunder Wave

missions.title: Volcanion Unleashed
missions.description: A Mythical Pokémon is sealed up tight in a Poké Ball that can't be opened. Help Mable open it up, and catch the Volcanion in your own Poké Ball
missions.guide:
Location : Pokemon Research Laboratory

At the Pokémon Research Lab, Mable will tell you that she has found a Poké Ball which has been hacked, and that this Poké Ball will contain the Mythical Pokémon Volcanion. She believes she's able to unhack the Poké Ball but needs your help to calm Volcanion down. She summons Yvonne, who works at the news agency and has studied Volcanion through some articles found there. It is then time to battle and catch Volcanion

missions.title: Restarting Magearna
missions.description: A very old mechanical Pokémon was recovered during some urban redevelopment work. Gather up the many Mega Shards needed to help awaken Magearna.
missions.guide:
At Quasartico Inc., Jett can be found in the lobby and asks for you to look at something, it's the Pokémon Magearna that they recovered during their recent redevelopment work and found in a dormant state. They want to awaken it but need to find a way to power its mechanisms and think a Mega Stone specific to Magearna would work. They had asked AZ to create one but it's not possible anymore so their team would do it, but you need to provide 999 Mega Shards to do so.

Return with the Mega Shards and the Magearnite will be ready. Activate your Mega Ring and Magearna will awaken. Jett will give you the Magearna and the Magearnite Mega Stone Magearna Level 80 OT: Jett ID: 981300 Hold Item: None Modest Nature. Date of Receiving Quasartico Inc.. Met at Lv. 80 Fleur Cannon Aura Sphere Flash Cannon Iron Head

missions.title: The Djinn Unbound
missions.description: Just as Taunie/Urbain was telling you about the Prison Bottle they found, a strange distortion appeared-and it seems linked to Hoopa. Something tells you this is no coincidence...
missions.guide:
At Hotel Z, Taunie/Urbain will let you know that they found an item while searching through AZ's room. This item is the Prison Bottle and causes Ansha's Hoopa to react to it unhappily. Corbeau then calls and says a distortion has appeared with some strange energy coming out it and it looks like Hoopa.  You go to investigate and are given the Prison Bottle. Go to the Hyperspace Portal and in there you will find Hoopa Unbound. Challenge it and you then use the Prison Bottle to change it to Hoopa Confined, where it then decides to go with you. Hoopa Level 80 OT: Yours ID: Yours Hold Item: None ??? Nature. Date of Receiving Hyperspace Lumiose. Met at Lv. 80 Hyperspace Hole Nasty Plot Psychic Phantom Force Afterwards, you return to Hotel Z and the two Hoopa interact. Ansha's Hoopa doesn't like the bottle so doesnt want to change forms but you can change yours at will.

Afterwards, you return to Hotel Z and the two Hoopa interact. Ansha's Hoopa doesn't like the bottle so doesnt want to change forms but you can change yours at will.

missions.title: Ultra-Hardcore Lucario Showdown
missions.description: Korrina has challenged you to a battle using traditional Tower of Mastery rules-one Lucario versus one Lucario. Take her on
missions.guide:
On the roof of Hotel Z, you will find Korrina. She will ask for you to battle with her in a unique way: She wants you to battle her using only Lucario.

Defeat her and she will mention how happy she was to have come to Lumiose and how the match reminded her of another match she did a long time ago.

missions.title: Lida's Lament
missions.description: Lida seems to be feeling a little sad that she hasn't made it as a dancer yet, while other people she knows are achieving their dreams. Lend her a friendly ear.
missions.guide:
At a Café in Vert Sector 3, you will find Lida. She will say she's feeling down seeing Ansha achieve her dream and asks for a chat. She will tell you about how she feels like she's behind, especially compared to her half brother Tierno, who she never met but is a famous dancer. After being reassured, she asks for a battle to help feel sure of herself.

Afer defeating her, Korrina appears and gives Lida so much praise for the battle and insists Lida is amazing. She relates to the struggles as she felt similar when she became the Mega Evolution Successor but she focuses on what she does know now.

missions.title: Naveen's Newfound Determination
missions.description: Naveen's family doesn't approve of his dream to be a designer, and now he doesn't seem interested in repairing his relationship with them. Can you do anything to help?
missions.guide:
In Hotel Z, you find Naveen who can't find something and is worried he left it at home. He asks Ansha for Hoopa to teleport home to grab it but Ansha declines saying that Hoopa doesn't run errans and one shouldn't expect others to do their work for them. Naveen accepts and decides to go home himself but needs to be psyched up so requests a battle.

Defeat him and he's happy, and explains that he's reluctant to go home due to his grandmother. Ansha understands and that you shouldn't do things that you hate doing, and that Naveen should be proud. Naveen decides to work on ways to use his skills to make his sister smile to hopefully get his grandma to appreciate his choices

missions.title: Here in Lumiose City
missions.description: Taunie/Urbain has been splitting their time between helping Jett at Quasartico and working with Team MZ, and they's been run ragged. Maybe they could use a hand from a friend like you.
missions.guide:
When you enter Hotel Z, Taunie/Urbain will call you and ask for help. They left a piece of paper with a password on it in their room and request you go read it to them. The password is Gp58JatW. They thank and run off to a meeting.

When Taunie/Urbain arrive, Jett joins them curious as to how Team MZ get along in AZ's hotel. She accepts that Taunie/Urbain  is very busy now working between Quasartico and Team MZ. When their training skills are called into question they decide to challenge you to one final battle.

After defeating them, they are happy but ask you to come to the roof to hang out and chat. They reminisce about all the times you have both gone through and are very happy with how things have gone and are thankful that you two are friends.

missions.title: Shine Bright like a Gemstone
missions.description: After picking up on some sort of psychic energy from one of your Mega Stones, Mimi got up and headed out. Where could Mimi be off to
missions.guide:
After you have received the Diancite, go to the Looker Bureau. When there, you can talk to Mimi and Emma will notice that Mimi is reacting to your Diancite and Mimi will leave. Your task is to follow Mimi. Mimi will start by leading you around to a food truck where you learn Emma is hungry by hearing her thoughts, presumably with Mimi's help. From there, you continue to chase Espurr through the city

Mimi will start by leading you around to a food truck where you learn Emma is hungry by hearing her thoughts, presumably with Mimi's help. From there, you continue to chase Espurr through the city

Eventually, Mimi leads you to a rooftop in Magenta Sector 8 filled with Mega Crystals. Soon after, two Carbink and a Diancie will appear and Emma suggests that you cath the Diancie.

After catching the Diancie, Emma will note it looks reminiscent of the Anistar Sundial and mention that AZ and Sycamore had a theory that Mega Evolution came to be when the Ultimate Weapon irradiated certain stones, and the reason why more Mega Evolutions have been discovered is because the Ultimate Weapon was fired again 5 years ago.

Emma then mentions that AZ mentioned that while searching for Floette, he went to Hoenn and saw a phenomenon he believes was the start of Mega Evolution.

missions.title: Project M
missions.description: The systems at the old Lysandre Labs have reactivated, unleashing a dangerous Pokémon that was once a research subject. This is an emergency—catch Mewtwo
missions.guide: After you have received the Mewtwonite X and Mewtwonite Y from an event distribution, if you go to Lysandre Labs and go to B3F, the laboratory will reactivate. Mable will call and ask what is going on and say that as part of Team Flare's Project M, Mewtwo is there and tells you to catch it. Mewtwo Level 70 OT: Yours ID: Yours Hold Item: None Any Nature. Date of Receiving Lysandre Labs. Met at Lv. 70 Psychic Aura Sphere Psycho Cut Amnesia

missions.title: Raging Lightning
missions.description: Emma got in touch about a hyperspace distortion in front of the Gare de Lumiose that's giving off a mysterious energy. What in the world could await beyond it?
missions.guide:
When you have beaten Rayquaza, caught Diancie & Mewtwo and done some Side Missions, a boy will appear on the roof of Vert Sector 3 and will trade various items. If you trade him a Canari Bread, he will give you the Popping Candy. Take this Candy to Ansha and she will be curious and try it. With this, she gets an idea for a Donut which needs  40 Sweet Points, 200 Spicy, 400 Sour, 280 Bitter and 40 Fresh. Our recommended Berry Recipe: 4* Hyper Kasib Berry. 3 * Hyper chilan Berry, 1 * Hyper Babiri Berry Make that donut with her and you get the Plasma Donut. Immediately, Emma phones and says a Hyperspace portal has appeared outside of the train station. Go there and you will see the portal in the screen.

Our recommended Berry Recipe: 4* Hyper Kasib Berry. 3 * Hyper chilan Berry, 1 * Hyper Babiri Berry

Corbeau will call and inform you of the portal and send Korrina to come help. With her and Emma, you have to go into Hyperspace where you face Rogue Mega Zeraora. It will attack by releasing Electrowebs throughout the stage and will often use Plasma Fists. First to send three out in various directions, and after 50% it will send them out at a zigzag through the stage and others swirling around.

Defeat it and you can catch Zeraora.

missions.title: Hyperspace Lumiose Survey No. 1
missions.description: What was that weird place you ended up in while you were chasing after Ansha? You're still processing what happened when a call comes from Corbeau, asking you to stop by... It's decided! You are to survey Hyperspace Lumiose for the Rust Syndicate. It seems Hoopa-the Pokémon that travels with Ansha-holds the key to your success.
missions.guide:
After the first stint to Hyperspace Lumiose, Corbeau invites you to the office to discuss the problem. He asks for you to investigate Hyperspace Lumiose. Alongside Vinnie, they upgrade yyour map to pick up on any of the distortions, and Ansha says she will help to make Donuts to open the portals. Your task is to go into Hyperspace and complete tasks to survey the area.

Defeat her and you'll get some Hyper Berries in order to open a portal to deal with the first Rogue Mega Evolution. When you arrive there, it is an Absol...but it Mega Evolves into a different Mega Evolution than before

Defeat it and you can catch it and get the Absolite Z Mega Stone, as well as some stronger butter

missions.title: Lebanne Arrives with a Bang!
missions.description: Your quiet morning was interrupted by the front door opening with a furious bang- followed by an equally furious Lebanne! Looks like you'll need to talk her down.
missions.guide:
The next morning,  Gwynn enters looking for some one and then Lebanne bursts in and asks for your help. She was looking after the daughter of a friend of Jacinthe and that child has disappeared. Ansha tries to explain that she's there but Lebanne immediately challenges to a battle, alongside Gwynn.

After the battle, Lebanne calms down but then realises that Ansha has been there the whole time. With Ansha asking to stay as she can't abandon her donuts or her dream, Lebanne lets her stay but makes sure Lebanne doesn't find out

missions.title: Hyperspace Lumiose Survey No. 2
