missions.description: Hotel Z is feeling quite lively with the recent addition of Ansha and Korrina. And it looks like your survey work in Hyperspace Lumiose has a long way to go before it's wrapped up.
missions.guide:
You have been summoned to Rust Syndicate as Corbeau and Vinnie have been able to pick up more Hyperspace distortions than before, and to make it worse, they're starting to have an effect over Lumiose City, so tasks you with completing more Hyperspace Surveys in order to find the next big portal.

You need to get 10,000 Points to continue. When you have achieved that, you can find a new portal on your map where another Rogue Mega Evolution is to show up. Korrina meets you there and before you enter, Taunie/Urbain rush in. You enter the portal to find a Staraptor

Defeat it and you can catch the Staraptor and you get its Mega Stone alongside the Great Butter to improve Donuts

missions.title: Le Musée et le Café
missions.description: Finally-a break from surveying Hyperspace Lumiose! Take this chance to join Ansha and Korrina for some sightseeing around the city before Corbeau inevitably calls you up again.
missions.guide:
Having had a slight nightmare, the next day Team MZ talks about how they're all helping out but in the time waiting for Corbeau, there's little to do so they recommend sightseeing in Lumiose City. First Ansha wants to go to Café Soleil, and then Korrina wants to go to Lumiose Museum. You start with the museum and look at the exhibits with Korrina and  Ansha.

After that, you can go to Café Soleil. Korrina and Ansha bond, with Ansha not too fond of the coffee but eventually you return to Hotel Z. While they were out, Naveen worked on a change for Ansha's apron, adding a Team MZ logo o it officially commemorating that she is now part of the team.

missions.title: A Boom from the Strategy Room
missions.description: What was that loud sound you heard in Team MZ's strategy meeting room? Could it be an intruder? Go search the room and see if you can find the source of the noise!
missions.guide: Suddenly, there is a sound from the Strategy Room in the hotel so you all go to investigate. When there, a Gulpin falls down, having appeared from Hyperspace Lumiose. You all decide that Gulpin can stay.

missions.title: Hyperspace Lumiose Survey No. 3
missions.description: Your investigation of Hyperspace Lumiose is slowly making progress, which has helped to calibrate the tools that detect distortions and unlock even more dangerous areas.
missions.guide:
You get called to Rust Syndicate where Corbeau says that the research is not going well and the distortion above it confounds. However, they have a theory that Hyperspace Lumiose is a melange of subconscious thought and it's a reflection of the subconscious of people and Pokémon, but it's continuing to expand. Corbeau gives some Exp. Candy which will help as Pokémon don't gain experience in Hyperspace Lumiose. It's time to go and complete more surveys

This tiem you need 15,000 points to complete the survey

Defeat it and you have the ability to catch Tatsugiri and obtain its Mega Stone as well as more butter to improve Ansha's donuts

missions.title: Naveen's Not OK
missions.description: Breakfast time has come and gone, yet there is still no sign of Naveen-only his Scrafty, who seems to want your attention. Time to go check on Naveen in his room!
missions.guide:
The next morning, Korrina is wondering who the strongest trainer between you and Taunie/Urbain is but it is thrown back to see what Korrina is doing when she's not in Hyperspace. However, Naveen hasn't come downstairs and his Scrafty soon appears in the lift so you all rush upstairs to check on Naveen

When in Naveen's room, you learn that his beloved Canari plush has gone missing, you all go to look for it but Gulpin appears with it, as it had rolled under the bed.

missions.title: Hyperspace Lumiose Survey No. 4
missions.description: The large distortion over the tower seems to be causing more and more trouble for Lumiose. This mystery must be solved before something terrible befalls the city!
missions.guide:
Corbeau then calls you to come to the Rust Syndicate Office for the next briefing. He mentions how Hyperspace Lumiose is still bleeding into Lumiose City so they have continued their research and have found my higher-level distortions. You are sent out again to do  some research. This time you need 20,000 Points to complete it

Defeat them and Jacinthe is happy with how Griselle battled and says she's welcome to participate in Le Super- Tournoi de Jacinthe Infinite at any time. Jacinthe then asks what you're doing there and wishes you well, but notices Lebanne hiding and states that she knows that Ansha has moved to Hotel Z and Lebanne pushed responsibility to Team MZ. Lebanne tries to explain the situation but gets punished that she has to win 100 Infinite matches in a row to be forgiven.

Defeat it and you can catch it and get its Mega Stone, as well as new butter.

missions.title: Hyperspace Lumiose Survey No. 5
missions.description: There seems to be a troubling possibility that Hyperspace Lumiose could simply swallow up the real Lumiose. Is there any way to stop it from expanding before it's too late?
missions.guide:
The next night, after the success meal with Team MZ and learning that Ansha's mother is Diantha, the former Kalos Champion, you have a nightmare again. The next day, Emma arrives and has Mimi try one of the donuts, and tells Ansha about the history of AZ and the hotel before giving you some Hyper Berries

You then get called by Corbeau and asked to head to the office. When there, you will find Canari calling on Corbeau to come out there as Ivor is there and she is mad that Gwynn is getting dragged into the scenario.  Corbeau suggests a battle against Canari and Ivor alongside you in order to solve the scenario. Bolts & Brawn Canari Ampharos Stunfisk Eelektross Battle Type Items Level 74 Level 74 Level 75 Attacks : Dazzling Gleam Thunder Attacks : Discharge Sludge Wave Attacks : Liquidation Flamethrower Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : Eelektrossite Bolts & Brawn Ivor Heracross Machamp Falinks Battle Type Items Level 73 Level 74 Level 75 Attacks : Stone Edge Megahorn Attacks : Earthquake Close Combat Attacks : Iron Head Close Combat Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : No Item Hold Item : Falinksite Ivor then explains the situation, that Corbeau inspired him to start a new training course to help prepare people. Eventually Canari relents and says she will help Gwynn out With the new data, you get sent to do more surveying, this time needing 28,000 Points to complete. After completing, you get a call that a new Pokémon is set to Rogue Mega Evolve and to go to it.

Ivor then explains the situation, that Corbeau inspired him to start a new training course to help prepare people. Eventually Canari relents and says she will help Gwynn out

With the new data, you get sent to do more surveying, this time needing 28,000 Points to complete. After completing, you get a call that a new Pokémon is set to Rogue Mega Evolve and to go to it.

Defeat it and you'll get to catch Heatran, get its Mega Stone and get some Hyperspace Butter for Ansha.

missions.title: Mayhem at Midnight
missions.description: Just when you thought you could finally get some rest, Lida's shouting roused the whole hotel! What is going on? Better check it out!
missions.guide:
The next night, Ansha helps Taunie/Urbain with dinner by adding to the Croissant Curry with a donut for Naveen. Later that night,  everyone gets woken by screaming from Lida. You go to her room to investigate and learn that  she is sleep dancing, and has Mega Evolved her Starmie in doing so. Korrina wakes her up and learns of what she was dreaming, about how she dances.

That night, you too have a nightmare of something calling for help.

missions.title: Hyperspace Lumiose Survey No. 6
missions.description: It sounds like the data you've been gathering finally led to a breakthrough. At last you can solve the mystery and stop Hyperspace Lumiose from fusing with the city!
missions.guide:
The next morning, Corbeau calls you and asks for you to go by but, before you can, you all get pulled into Hyperspace Lumiose again, but without Hoopa opening the portal. It's starting to merge with Lumiose City. Explore the area and you will find Corbeau and start discussing the situation, but then get sent back to Lumiose City. Corbeau and Philippe arrive and then say how they have worked out that there's only a single Pokémon creating and sustaining Hyperspace Lumiose, as it was exposed to the Mega Power from the tower and is likely to go Rogue.

They work out that with the Donuts, you can use Mega Evolution to power it up to create a portal to get in. They need to figure out the recipe for the donut but need you to do more Survey Research to get there. This time for 50,000 Points

Our recommended Berry Recipe: 3* Hyper Tanga Berry. 3 * Hyper Kasib Berry, 1 * Hyper Coba Berry, 1 * Hyper Yache Berry

With this, you can make the Bad Dreams Cruller. Take it to Prism Tower and everyone will appear in a circle around the tower and use their Mega Power, giving Hoopa the power to alter the donut and open the portal.

Darkrai has a passive feature where if you are Drowsy near it, its Bad Dreams will sap your Pokémon's health

Defeat it and you can catch it and get its Mega Stone

missions.title: The Greatest Gift
missions.description: The mysteries of hyperspace have been unraveled, but Ansha's original goal still remains unfulfilled. More survey work may be needed to find that Legendary Pokémon! Rayquaza, the Legendary Pokémon Ansha seeks, should be waiting on the other side of the emerald distortion that has appeared. Make a special donut and prepare to catch it!
missions.guide:
With Lumiose City saved, Ansha asks that you continue to help her find the Rayquaza that she saw and Corbeau soon calls to get support. He mentions that while researching Darkrai, they found several odd readings of distortions in the city, the Ruby Distortion and Sapphire Distortion and that they're linked to Rayquaza. Lida, having come from Hoenn gives some history on Groudon and Kyogre and that they fought but Rayquaza came to calm them.

Corbeau mentinos that special donuts will have to be made and that you need to do more Hyperspace Surveys to find out. He also mentions that portals to Rogue Mega Evolution rematches have appeared which give big points and a lot of items.

Soon after, the big portal appears above Hotel Z. They continue to discuss about Rayquaza and learn that it can Mega Evolve without the Mega Stone.

Philippe then comes in and mentions that you need more Hyperspace Survey Research to figure the recipt. This requires 100,000 Points.

After completion of the survey, Corbeau and Philippe arrive with the recipe to make. This requires 120 points in sweet, 40 points in spicy, 340 points in sour, 40 points in bitter and 390 points in fresh. Make ti to get the Delta Old Fashined Donut. Then take it to the portal to go to the Hyperspace Sky Ruins

missions.title: A Ruby-Red Legend
missions.description: You've learned that Groudon dwells on the other side of the ruby distortion. Make the special donut needed to enter Groudon's pocket of hyperspace, then go and catch it!
missions.guide:
With the recipes obtained, you have to make the Omega Old Fashioned Donut. This is done by needing 260 points in sweet, 160 in spicy, 160 in sour, 20 in bitter, and 260 in fresh.

Our recommended Berry Recipe: 3* Hyper Colbur Berry. 2 * Hyper Coba  Berry, 2 * Hyper Haban Berry, 1 * Hyper Tanga Berry

With the donut made, the portal can be found in Jaune Sector 11. Go there and Korrina & Urbain/Taunie will join you.

Defeat it and you can catch it and get the Red Orb

missions.title: A Sapphire-Blue Legend
missions.description: You've learned that Kyogre dwells on the other side of the sapphire distortion. Make the special donut needed to enter Kyogre's pocket of hyperspace, then go and catch it!
missions.guide:
With the recipes obtained, you have to make the Alpha Old Fashioned Donut. This is done by needing  50 points in sweet, 50 in spicy, 210 in sour, 180 in bitter, and 370 in fresh.

Our recommended Berry Recipe: 4* Hyper Colbur Berry. 2* Hyper Charti Berry, 1 * Hyper Coba Berry, 1* Hyper Haban Berry

With the donut made, the portal can be found in Wild Zone 5. Go there and Korrina & Urbain/Taunie will join you.

Defeat it and you can catch it and get the Blue Orb
